pairs.source_zh: 惟有那名代表漕帮说话的尖丁，大摇其头。
pairs.source_en: Only the headman who had spoken for the associations shook his head firmly.
pairs.zh: 惟有那名代表漕帮说话的尖丁，大摇其头。
pairs.en: Only the headman who had spoken for the associations shook his head firmly.

pairs.source_zh: 不过他首先声明，他自己有点意见，并有代表漕帮，
pairs.source_en: Before explaining, however, he made it clear that he had a personal opinion and was not speaking on behalf of the associations.
pairs.zh: 不过他首先声明，他自己有点意见，并有代表漕帮，
pairs.en: Before explaining, however, he made it clear that he had a personal opinion and was not speaking on behalf of the associations.

pairs.source_zh: 不知该说不该说？
pairs.source_en: He was unsure whether he ought to express it.
pairs.zh: 不知该说不该说？
pairs.en: He was unsure whether he ought to express it.

pairs.source_zh: “说，说！
pairs.source_en: “Go on!
pairs.zh: “说，说！
pairs.en: “Go on!

pairs.source_zh: 集思广益，
pairs.source_en: We need everyone's ideas.
pairs.zh: 集思广益，
pairs.en: We need everyone's ideas.

pairs.source_zh: 说出来商量。”
pairs.source_en: Tell us, and we can discuss it.”
pairs.zh: 说出来商量。”
pairs.en: Tell us, and we can discuss it.”

pairs.source_zh: 照那尖丁个人的看法，漕船要能开行，首先得要疏浚河床，同时在各支流加闸，提高运河中的水位，
pairs.source_en: In the headman's personal view, getting the boats moving would first require dredging the channel and installing gates on the tributaries to raise the water level in the canal.
pairs.zh: 照那尖丁个人的看法，漕船要能开行，首先得要疏浚河床，同时在各支流加闸，提高运河中的水位，
pairs.en: In the headman's personal view, getting the boats moving would first require dredging the channel and installing gates on the tributaries to raise the water level in the canal.

pairs.source_zh: 然后另雇民船分载漕米，减轻漕船的载重，
pairs.source_en: Civilian boats would then have to be hired to take part of the grain and lighten the official vessels.
pairs.zh: 然后另雇民船分载漕米，减轻漕船的载重，
pairs.en: Civilian boats would then have to be hired to take part of the grain and lighten the official vessels.

pairs.source_zh: 这样双管齐下，才有“动”的可能。
pairs.source_en: Only by combining these two measures would movement be possible.
pairs.zh: 这样双管齐下，才有“动”的可能。
pairs.en: Only by combining these two measures would movement be possible.

pairs.source_zh: “那就这样办啊！
pairs.source_en: “Then let us do precisely that!
pairs.zh: “那就这样办啊！
pairs.en: “Then let us do precisely that!

pairs.source_zh: 有何不可呢？”有个押运官兴奋地说。
pairs.source_en: What is there to prevent us?” one escort official exclaimed excitedly.
pairs.zh: 有何不可呢？”有个押运官兴奋地说。
pairs.en: What is there to prevent us?” one escort official exclaimed excitedly.

pairs.source_zh: 那尖丁苦笑了一下，没有作声。
pairs.source_en: The headman gave a bitter smile and said nothing.
pairs.zh: 那尖丁苦笑了一下，没有作声。
pairs.en: The headman gave a bitter smile and said nothing.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿却明白他的意思，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou, however, understood.
pairs.zh: 椿寿却明白他的意思，
pairs.en: Chunshou, however, understood.

pairs.source_zh: 以讥嘲的口吻答道：“老兄说得容易！
pairs.source_en: “You make it sound easy,” he replied sarcastically.
pairs.zh: 以讥嘲的口吻答道：“老兄说得容易！
pairs.en: “You make it sound easy,” he replied sarcastically.

pairs.source_zh: 可知道这一来要多少钱？”
pairs.source_en: “Have you any idea what it would cost?”
pairs.zh: 可知道这一来要多少钱？”
pairs.en: “Have you any idea what it would cost?”

pairs.source_zh: “于其赔累，何不把赔累的钱，花在疏浚河床和雇用民船上？
pairs.source_en: “Rather than pay compensation, why not spend the money on dredging and hiring boats?
pairs.zh: “于其赔累，何不把赔累的钱，花在疏浚河床和雇用民船上？
pairs.en: “Rather than pay compensation, why not spend the money on dredging and hiring boats?

pairs.source_zh: 不但交的差，而且治理了运河，
pairs.source_en: That would not only fulfil the transport obligation but improve the canal as well.
pairs.zh: 不但交的差，而且治理了运河，
pairs.en: That would not only fulfil the transport obligation but improve the canal as well.

pairs.source_zh: 也是大人的劳绩。”
pairs.source_en: It would be an achievement to Your Excellency's credit.”
pairs.zh: 也是大人的劳绩。”
pairs.en: It would be an achievement to Your Excellency's credit.”

pairs.source_zh: 这两句话说动了椿寿的心，
pairs.source_en: The argument appealed to Chunshou.
pairs.zh: 这两句话说动了椿寿的心，
pairs.en: The argument appealed to Chunshou.

pairs.source_zh: 点着头沉吟，
pairs.source_en: He nodded thoughtfully.
pairs.zh: 点着头沉吟，
pairs.en: He nodded thoughtfully.

pairs.source_zh: “这倒也是一说。”他自语似的问：“就不知道要多少日子？”
pairs.source_en: “There is something in that,” he murmured. “The question is how long it would take.”
pairs.zh: “这倒也是一说。”他自语似的问：“就不知道要多少日子？”
pairs.en: “There is something in that,” he murmured. “The question is how long it would take.”

pairs.source_zh: 疏浚的计划，施工的日程，要多少工、多少料，都要仔细计算，才能知道确数，
pairs.source_en: The dredging plan, the construction schedule, and the labour and materials required all had to be carefully calculated before a definite answer could be given.
pairs.zh: 疏浚的计划，施工的日程，要多少工、多少料，都要仔细计算，才能知道确数，
pairs.en: The dredging plan, the construction schedule, and the labour and materials required all had to be carefully calculated before a definite answer could be given.

pairs.source_zh: 在这样人多口杂的场台中，是不可能得到结果的，
pairs.source_en: Nothing of the sort could be settled in a crowded meeting where everyone was talking.
pairs.zh: 在这样人多口杂的场台中，是不可能得到结果的，
pairs.en: Nothing of the sort could be settled in a crowded meeting where everyone was talking.

pairs.source_zh: 所以椿寿叫大家散一散，别外找了些实际能负责，能办事的人来重作商量。
pairs.source_en: Chunshou therefore dismissed the gathering and summoned a smaller group of people who could actually take responsibility and get things done.
pairs.zh: 所以椿寿叫大家散一散，别外找了些实际能负责，能办事的人来重作商量。
pairs.en: Chunshou therefore dismissed the gathering and summoned a smaller group of people who could actually take responsibility and get things done.

pairs.source_zh: 这个少数人的集议，首先要谈的就是工料的来源。
pairs.source_en: Their first concern was where the labour and materials would come from.
pairs.zh: 这个少数人的集议，首先要谈的就是工料的来源。
pairs.en: Their first concern was where the labour and materials would come from.

pairs.source_zh: 这实在也只有一个字：钱。
pairs.source_en: In the end, that came down to a single word: money.
pairs.zh: 这实在也只有一个字：钱。
pairs.en: In the end, that came down to a single word: money.

pairs.source_zh: 漕帮中被推派出来说话的那名尖丁，以久历江湖的经验，预感到此举不妥，
pairs.source_en: Drawing on his long experience of the world, the headman who had represented the associations sensed that the undertaking would end badly.
pairs.zh: 漕帮中被推派出来说话的那名尖丁，以久历江湖的经验，预感到此举不妥，
pairs.en: Drawing on his long experience of the world, the headman who had represented the associations sensed that the undertaking would end badly.

pairs.source_zh: 但人微言轻，无法扭转椿寿的“如意算盘”，
pairs.source_en: But a man of his low standing had little influence and could not overturn Chunshou's hopeful calculations.
pairs.zh: 但人微言轻，无法扭转椿寿的“如意算盘”，
pairs.en: But a man of his low standing had little influence and could not overturn Chunshou's hopeful calculations.

pairs.source_zh: 便很干脆地答应了所派的经费，而且保证漕帮一定全力支持这件事。
pairs.source_en: He therefore readily accepted the sum assigned to the associations and promised their full support.
pairs.zh: 便很干脆地答应了所派的经费，而且保证漕帮一定全力支持这件事。
pairs.en: He therefore readily accepted the sum assigned to the associations and promised their full support.

pairs.source_zh: 不过他也很郑重地声明，漕帮出了这笔钱，漕船不管如何非走不可。
pairs.source_en: At the same time, he made one solemn condition: once they paid this money, the boats had to sail, come what might.
pairs.zh: 不过他也很郑重地声明，漕帮出了这笔钱，漕船不管如何非走不可。
pairs.en: At the same time, he made one solemn condition: once they paid this money, the boats had to sail, come what might.

pairs.source_zh: 如果再出了什么花样。漕帮不能负责。
pairs.source_en: If anything else went wrong, the associations would accept no further liability.
pairs.zh: 如果再出了什么花样。漕帮不能负责。
pairs.en: If anything else went wrong, the associations would accept no further liability.

pairs.source_zh: 于是疏浚河道的计划，很快地便见诸实际行动。
pairs.source_en: The dredging scheme was soon put into effect.
pairs.zh: 于是疏浚河道的计划，很快地便见诸实际行动。
pairs.en: The dredging scheme was soon put into effect.

pairs.source_zh: 这件事地方官原来也有责任，只是湖州府和运河所经的乌程、归安、德清三县，要办这件事惟有派工派料。
pairs.source_en: The local authorities had responsibilities in the matter too, but Huzhou prefecture and the three counties through which the canal passed—Wucheng, Gui'an, and Deqing—could act only by requisitioning labour and materials.
pairs.zh: 这件事地方官原来也有责任，只是湖州府和运河所经的乌程、归安、德清三县，要办这件事惟有派工派料。
pairs.en: The local authorities had responsibilities in the matter too, but Huzhou prefecture and the three counties through which the canal passed—Wucheng, Gui'an, and Deqing—could act only by requisitioning labour and materials.

pairs.source_zh: 公文往返，以及召集绅士磋商，需要好久才能动工，未免缓不济急。
pairs.source_en: The exchange of official documents and consultations with local gentry would take so long that work could not begin soon enough to meet the emergency.
pairs.zh: 公文往返，以及召集绅士磋商，需要好久才能动工，未免缓不济急。
pairs.en: The exchange of official documents and consultations with local gentry would take so long that work could not begin soon enough to meet the emergency.

pairs.source_zh: 为了与天争时，自己拿钱出来征雇民工是最切实的办法。
pairs.source_en: With time running out, the most practical solution was to supply the money themselves and hire local labourers.
pairs.zh: 为了与天争时，自己拿钱出来征雇民工是最切实的办法。
pairs.en: With time running out, the most practical solution was to supply the money themselves and hire local labourers.

pairs.source_zh: 等这一切安排好了，预计八月底以前，漕船一定可以开行。
pairs.source_en: Once these arrangements were made, it was estimated that the boats would certainly be able to sail before the end of the eighth month.
pairs.zh: 等这一切安排好了，预计八月底以前，漕船一定可以开行。
pairs.en: Once these arrangements were made, it was estimated that the boats would certainly be able to sail before the end of the eighth month.

pairs.source_zh: 这样，椿寿才算松了一口气，动身回省。
pairs.source_en: Only then did Chunshou breathe more easily and set off for the provincial capital.
pairs.zh: 这样，椿寿才算松了一口气，动身回省。
pairs.en: Only then did Chunshou breathe more easily and set off for the provincial capital.

pairs.source_zh: 走的那天，秋风秋雨，一般行旅闷损不乐的天气，
pairs.source_en: On the day he left, autumn wind and rain made the weather miserable for most travellers.
pairs.zh: 走的那天，秋风秋雨，一般行旅闷损不乐的天气，
pairs.en: On the day he left, autumn wind and rain made the weather miserable for most travellers.

pairs.source_zh: 在椿寿却大为高兴，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou, however, was delighted.
pairs.zh: 在椿寿却大为高兴，
pairs.en: Chunshou, however, was delighted.

pairs.source_zh: 心里在想，这雨最好落大些，连下几天，
pairs.source_en: Let the rain grow heavier, he thought, and continue for several days.
pairs.zh: 心里在想，这雨最好落大些，连下几天，
pairs.en: Let the rain grow heavier, he thought, and continue for several days.

pairs.source_zh: 前溪水涨，起漕的时间，还好提前。
pairs.source_en: If the streams ahead rose, the grain boats might depart even sooner.
pairs.zh: 前溪水涨，起漕的时间，还好提前。
pairs.en: If the streams ahead rose, the grain boats might depart even sooner.

pairs.source_zh: * * *回到省城，他第一件事便是去见抚台黄宗汉。
pairs.source_en: On returning to the provincial capital, his first act was to call on Governor Huang Zonghan.
pairs.zh: * * *回到省城，他第一件事便是去见抚台黄宗汉。
pairs.en: On returning to the provincial capital, his first act was to call on Governor Huang Zonghan.

pairs.source_zh: 听完报告，黄宗汉还夸奖了一番，说他实心办事。
pairs.source_en: After hearing his report, Huang actually praised his conscientious work.
pairs.zh: 听完报告，黄宗汉还夸奖了一番，说他实心办事。
pairs.en: After hearing his report, Huang actually praised his conscientious work.

pairs.source_zh: 还告诉他一些京里来的消息，
pairs.source_en: He also passed on news from the capital.
pairs.zh: 还告诉他一些京里来的消息，
pairs.en: He also passed on news from the capital.

pairs.source_zh: 说朝廷已有旨意，严饬直隶总督和驻北通州的仓场侍郎，自天津杨村地方，调派一千五百艘驳船到山东临清，准备驳运漕粮。
pairs.source_en: The court had ordered the governor-general of Zhili and the granary vice-minister stationed at North Tongzhou to send fifteen hundred barges from Yangcun near Tianjin to Linqing in Shandong, ready to take over the grain.
pairs.zh: 说朝廷已有旨意，严饬直隶总督和驻北通州的仓场侍郎，自天津杨村地方，调派一千五百艘驳船到山东临清，准备驳运漕粮。
pairs.en: The court had ordered the governor-general of Zhili and the granary vice-minister stationed at North Tongzhou to send fifteen hundred barges from Yangcun near Tianjin to Linqing in Shandong, ready to take over the grain.

pairs.source_zh: 不过直隶总督已经复奏，怕杨村的驳船，到达临清，河水已经结冰，
pairs.source_en: The governor-general of Zhili had replied, however, that the river might be frozen by the time the Yangcun barges reached Linqing.
pairs.zh: 不过直隶总督已经复奏，怕杨村的驳船，到达临清，河水已经结冰，
pairs.en: The governor-general of Zhili had replied, however, that the river might be frozen by the time the Yangcun barges reached Linqing.

pairs.source_zh: 所以这样请求：江浙的漕粮在临清、德州一带卸下来，暂时存贮，到明年开春解冻，再转漕北上，
pairs.source_en: He proposed that the grain from Jiangsu and Zhejiang be unloaded around Linqing and Dezhou and stored there until the spring thaw, then sent north.
pairs.zh: 所以这样请求：江浙的漕粮在临清、德州一带卸下来，暂时存贮，到明年开春解冻，再转漕北上，
pairs.en: He proposed that the grain from Jiangsu and Zhejiang be unloaded around Linqing and Dezhou and stored there until the spring thaw, then sent north.

pairs.source_zh: 这个请求，能不能奉准，尚不可知。
pairs.source_en: Whether the request would be approved was not yet known.
pairs.zh: 这个请求，能不能奉准，尚不可知。
pairs.en: Whether the request would be approved was not yet known.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿认为这是个好消息，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou regarded this as good news.
pairs.zh: 椿寿认为这是个好消息，
pairs.en: Chunshou regarded this as good news.

pairs.source_zh: 他原有顾虑，怕北地天寒，到了十月以后，河里结冰，漕船依旧受阻。
pairs.source_en: He had been worried that the northern cold would freeze the rivers after the tenth month and leave the grain boats obstructed once again.
pairs.zh: 他原有顾虑，怕北地天寒，到了十月以后，河里结冰，漕船依旧受阻。
pairs.en: He had been worried that the northern cold would freeze the rivers after the tenth month and leave the grain boats obstructed once again.

pairs.source_zh: 现在既有直隶总督据实奏陈，等于为他把心里想说的话说了出来，
pairs.source_en: Now the governor-general of Zhili had reported the facts, effectively saying what Chunshou himself had wanted to say.
pairs.zh: 现在既有直隶总督据实奏陈，等于为他把心里想说的话说了出来，
pairs.en: Now the governor-general of Zhili had reported the facts, effectively saying what Chunshou himself had wanted to say.

pairs.source_zh: 格于事实，朝廷不能不准，
pairs.source_en: Faced with reality, the court could scarcely refuse.
pairs.zh: 格于事实，朝廷不能不准，
pairs.en: Faced with reality, the court could scarcely refuse.

pairs.source_zh: 这样就只要到了临清，便算达成任务。
pairs.source_en: Reaching Linqing would therefore count as completion of the task.
pairs.zh: 这样就只要到了临清，便算达成任务。
pairs.en: Reaching Linqing would therefore count as completion of the task.

pairs.source_zh: 倘说迟延，则各地情形相同，
pairs.source_en: As for any delay, conditions were the same for everyone.
pairs.zh: 倘说迟延，则各地情形相同，
pairs.en: As for any delay, conditions were the same for everyone.

pairs.source_zh: 处分的案子混在一起，变成“通案”就不要紧了。
pairs.source_en: The disciplinary cases would be combined into a general case, and the matter would lose its danger.
pairs.zh: 处分的案子混在一起，变成“通案”就不要紧了。
pairs.en: The disciplinary cases would be combined into a general case, and the matter would lose its danger.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿吃了这颗定心丸，对于疏浚河道的工程，进度不甚理想，就不太着急。
pairs.source_en: With this reassurance, Chunshou became less anxious about the unsatisfactory progress of the dredging.
pairs.zh: 椿寿吃了这颗定心丸，对于疏浚河道的工程，进度不甚理想，就不太着急。
pairs.en: With this reassurance, Chunshou became less anxious about the unsatisfactory progress of the dredging.

pairs.source_zh: 他最关心的是直隶总督那个复奏的下文，
pairs.source_en: What interested him most was the response to the governor-general's memorial.
pairs.zh: 他最关心的是直隶总督那个复奏的下文，
pairs.en: What interested him most was the response to the governor-general's memorial.

pairs.source_zh: 等漕船开出，才看到明发上谕：“浙江嘉杭等帮米石，如能拨船赶运，当仍遵前旨，
pairs.source_en: Only after the boats had sailed did he see the publicly circulated imperial edict: “If the rice carried by the Jiaxing, Hangzhou, and other Zhejiang fleets can be expedited by allocating additional vessels, the previous order shall remain in force.
pairs.zh: 等漕船开出，才看到明发上谕：“浙江嘉杭等帮米石，如能拨船赶运，当仍遵前旨，
pairs.en: Only after the boats had sailed did he see the publicly circulated imperial edict: “If the rice carried by the Jiaxing, Hangzhou, and other Zhejiang fleets can be expedited by allocating additional vessels, the previous order shall remain in force.

pairs.source_zh: 酌拨杨村船只，趁此天气晴和，迅往拨运。
pairs.source_en: A suitable number of boats from Yangcun shall be sent promptly to transfer it while the weather remains fine and mild.
pairs.zh: 酌拨杨村船只，趁此天气晴和，迅往拨运。
pairs.en: A suitable number of boats from Yangcun shall be sent promptly to transfer it while the weather remains fine and mild.

pairs.source_zh: 设或沿途必须截卸，临情、德州等仓，是否足资容纳？
pairs.source_en: Should unloading en route prove unavoidable, do the granaries at Linqing, Dezhou, and elsewhere have sufficient capacity?
pairs.zh: 设或沿途必须截卸，临情、德州等仓，是否足资容纳？
pairs.en: Should unloading en route prove unavoidable, do the granaries at Linqing, Dezhou, and elsewhere have sufficient capacity?

pairs.source_zh: 着仓场侍郎、直隶总督、漕运总督、山东巡抚各将现在应办急务，迅速妥为办理，
pairs.source_en: The granary vice-minister, the governor-general of Zhili, the director-general of grain transport, and the governor of Shandong shall each promptly and properly attend to the urgent duties before them.
pairs.zh: 着仓场侍郎、直隶总督、漕运总督、山东巡抚各将现在应办急务，迅速妥为办理，
pairs.en: The granary vice-minister, the governor-general of Zhili, the director-general of grain transport, and the governor of Shandong shall each promptly and properly attend to the urgent duties before them.

pairs.source_zh: 毋得听任属员推诿恶习，各分畛域，再赴贻误。
pairs.source_en: They must not permit their subordinates to persist in shirking responsibility, confining themselves to their own jurisdictions, and causing further delay.
pairs.zh: 毋得听任属员推诿恶习，各分畛域，再赴贻误。

pairs.source_zh: 懔之！“

pairs.zh: 懔之！“

pairs.en: If the Huzhou grain arrives and there is nowhere to put it, we shall have a difficult problem.”

pairs.source_en: He therefore went to see the governor.

pairs.en: He therefore went to see the governor.

pairs.en: As soon as Huang saw him, he said, “Ah, just in time!

pairs.source_zh: 我正要叫‘戈什哈’去请你，
pairs.source_en: I was about to send an attendant for you.
pairs.zh: 我正要叫‘戈什哈’去请你，
pairs.en: I was about to send an attendant for you.

pairs.source_zh: 有件要紧事商量。”
pairs.source_en: There is an important matter we must discuss.”
pairs.zh: 有件要紧事商量。”

pairs.source_zh: “请大人吩咐。”
pairs.source_en: “Please give me your instructions, Your Excellency.”
pairs.zh: “请大人吩咐。”
pairs.en: “Please give me your instructions, Your Excellency.”

pairs.source_zh: “不，不！
pairs.source_en: “No, no.
pairs.zh: “不，不！
pairs.en: “No, no.

pairs.source_zh: 你有事你先说。”
pairs.source_en: If you have business, speak first.”
pairs.zh: 你有事你先说。”
pairs.en: If you have business, speak first.”

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿便说明来意，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou explained why he had come.

pairs.en: Chunshou explained why he had come.

pairs.en: He wished the governor to submit a memorial stating that the grain boats of Huzhou's eight associations had left Zhejiang and were heading north.

pairs.en: If they reached Linqing but could not transfer their cargo and had to unload it, the director-general of grain transport and the governor of Shandong should be instructed to reserve empty granaries.

pairs.source_zh: 他是怕湖属八帮的漕船最后到达，仓位为他帮捷足先登，所以有此要求。
pairs.source_en: Chunshou feared that the Huzhou boats would arrive last, after other fleets had occupied all the available space.

pairs.en: Chunshou feared that the Huzhou boats would arrive last, after other fleets had occupied all the available space.

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉一面听，一面不断摇头，
pairs.source_en: Huang shook his head repeatedly as he listened.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉一面听，一面不断摇头，
pairs.en: Huang shook his head repeatedly as he listened.

pairs.source_zh: 等他说完，俯身向前问道：“漕运一事，贵司内行，而且今年由贵司一手料理，
pairs.source_en: When Chunshou finished, he leaned forward. “You are the expert on grain transport, and this year you have managed it entirely yourself.
pairs.zh: 等他说完，俯身向前问道：“漕运一事，贵司内行，而且今年由贵司一手料理，
pairs.en: When Chunshou finished, he leaned forward. “You are the expert on grain transport, and this year you have managed it entirely yourself.

pairs.source_zh: 我要请问，可曾计算过‘回空’的日子？”
pairs.source_en: May I ask whether you have calculated when the empty boats will return?”
pairs.zh: 我要请问，可曾计算过‘回空’的日子？”
pairs.en: May I ask whether you have calculated when the empty boats will return?”

pairs.source_zh: 原来是这一层顾虑，
pairs.source_en: So that was his concern.
pairs.zh: 原来是这一层顾虑，
pairs.en: So that was his concern.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿略略放了心，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou felt a little relieved.
pairs.zh: 椿寿略略放了心，
pairs.en: Chunshou felt a little relieved.

pairs.source_zh: “回大人的话，”他说，“回空自然要衍期……”
pairs.source_en: “Your Excellency, their return will naturally be delayed...”
pairs.zh: “回大人的话，”他说，“回空自然要衍期……”
pairs.en: “Your Excellency, their return will naturally be delayed...”

pairs.source_zh: “衍期多少时候？”黄宗汉不待辞毕，枪着问道，
pairs.source_en: “By how long?” Huang interrupted.
pairs.zh: “衍期多少时候？”黄宗汉不待辞毕，枪着问道，
pairs.en: “By how long?” Huang interrupted.

pairs.source_zh: “请贵司算与我听一听。”
pairs.source_en: “Please work it out for me.”
pairs.zh: “请贵司算与我听一听。”
pairs.en: “Please work it out for me.”

pairs.source_zh: “这要看临清的情形。
pairs.source_en: “That depends on conditions at Linqing.
pairs.zh: “这要看临清的情形。
pairs.en: “That depends on conditions at Linqing.

pairs.source_zh: 如果在那里截卸，等明年开冻驳运，又要看前面漕船的多寡，
pairs.source_en: If the grain is unloaded there and transferred after the thaw next year, it will also depend on the number of boats ahead of ours.
pairs.zh: 如果在那里截卸，等明年开冻驳运，又要看前面漕船的多寡，
pairs.en: If the grain is unloaded there and transferred after the thaw next year, it will also depend on the number of boats ahead of ours.

pairs.source_zh: 多则慢，少则快。
pairs.source_en: The more there are, the longer it will take.”
pairs.zh: 多则慢，少则快。
pairs.en: The more there are, the longer it will take.”

pairs.source_zh: “最快什么时候？”
pairs.source_en: “What is the earliest possible date?”
pairs.zh: “最快什么时候？”
pairs.en: “What is the earliest possible date?”

pairs.source_zh: “总要到明年四月。”
pairs.source_en: “Not before the fourth month of next year.”
pairs.zh: “总要到明年四月。”
pairs.en: “Not before the fourth month of next year.”

pairs.source_zh: “回空呢？”
pairs.source_en: “And the return journey?”
pairs.zh: “回空呢？”
pairs.en: “And the return journey?”

pairs.source_zh: “也要两个月。”
pairs.source_en: “That would take another two months.”
pairs.zh: “也要两个月。”
pairs.en: “That would take another two months.”

pairs.source_zh: “这就是说，漕船明年夏天才能回家，
pairs.source_en: “So the boats will not return home until next summer.
pairs.zh: “这就是说，漕船明年夏天才能回家，
pairs.en: “So the boats will not return home until next summer.

pairs.source_zh: 还要经过一番修补，又得费个把月，
pairs.source_en: They will then need repairs, which will take another month or so.
pairs.zh: 还要经过一番修补，又得费个把月，
pairs.en: They will then need repairs, which will take another month or so.

pairs.source_zh: 最快也得在七月里才能到各县受兑漕米。
pairs.source_en: At the earliest, they will not be ready to collect grain from the counties until the seventh month.
pairs.zh: 最快也得在七月里才能到各县受兑漕米。
pairs.en: At the earliest, they will not be ready to collect grain from the counties until the seventh month.

pairs.source_zh: 请问贵司，明年新漕，不是又跟今年一样，迟到八九月才能启运吗？”
pairs.source_en: Tell me, then: will next year's new grain not be delayed until the eighth or ninth month, just like this year's?”
pairs.zh: 请问贵司，明年新漕，不是又跟今年一样，迟到八九月才能启运吗？”
pairs.en: Tell me, then: will next year's new grain not be delayed until the eighth or ninth month, just like this year's?”

pairs.source_zh: “是！”椿寿答道，
pairs.source_en: “Yes,” Chunshou answered.
pairs.zh: “是！”椿寿答道，
pairs.en: “Yes,” Chunshou answered.

pairs.source_zh: “不过明年改用海运，亦无关系。”
pairs.source_en: “But next year we shall use sea transport, so it will not matter.”
pairs.zh: “不过明年改用海运，亦无关系。”
pairs.en: “But next year we shall use sea transport, so it will not matter.”

pairs.source_zh: “什么叫没有关系？”
pairs.source_en: “What do you mean, it will not matter?”
pairs.zh: “什么叫没有关系？”
pairs.en: “What do you mean, it will not matter?”

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉勃然变色，
pairs.source_en: Huang's expression changed sharply.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉勃然变色，
pairs.en: Huang's expression changed sharply.

pairs.source_zh: “你说得好轻巧。
pairs.source_en: “You speak very lightly of it.
pairs.zh: “你说得好轻巧。
pairs.en: “You speak very lightly of it.

pairs.source_zh: 年年把漕期延后，何时始得恢复正常？
pairs.source_en: If the schedule slips later every year, when will it ever return to normal?
pairs.zh: 年年把漕期延后，何时始得恢复正常？
pairs.en: If the schedule slips later every year, when will it ever return to normal?

pairs.source_zh: 须知今年是贵司责无旁贷，明年就完全是我的责任。
pairs.source_en: This year's responsibility rests squarely on you; next year's will be entirely mine.
pairs.zh: 须知今年是贵司责无旁贷，明年就完全是我的责任。
pairs.en: This year's responsibility rests squarely on you; next year's will be entirely mine.

pairs.source_zh: 贵司这样子做法，简直是有意跟我过不去呀！”
pairs.source_en: The way you are handling this, one would think you were deliberately trying to make trouble for me!”
pairs.zh: 贵司这样子做法，简直是有意跟我过不去呀！”
pairs.en: The way you are handling this, one would think you were deliberately trying to make trouble for me!”

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿一看抚台变脸，大出意外，
pairs.source_en: The governor's sudden anger took Chunshou completely by surprise.

pairs.en: The governor's sudden anger took Chunshou completely by surprise.

pairs.source_zh: 他亦是旗下公子哥儿出身，一个忍不住，当即顶撞了过去：“大人言重了！

pairs.zh: 他亦是旗下公子哥儿出身，一个忍不住，当即顶撞了过去：“大人言重了！
pairs.en: He too had been raised as a privileged bannerman, and for a moment he lost his restraint. “Your Excellency goes too far!

pairs.source_zh: 既然我责无旁贷，该杀该剐，自然由我负责，
pairs.source_en: If the responsibility is mine, then I shall answer for it, even if I must be executed.
pairs.zh: 既然我责无旁贷，该杀该剐，自然由我负责，
pairs.en: If the responsibility is mine, then I shall answer for it, even if I must be executed.

pairs.source_zh: 大人何必如此气急败坏？”

pairs.zh: 大人何必如此气急败坏？”
pairs.en: There is no need for Your Excellency to lose his temper in this fashion.”

pairs.source_en: “Very well! Very well!”

pairs.en: Huang was partly angry and partly acting.

pairs.source_zh: 脸上一阵青，一阵红地说：“你负责，你负责！

pairs.zh: 脸上一阵青，一阵红地说：“你负责，你负责！
pairs.en: His face alternated between pallor and a flush. “You will answer for it, will you?

pairs.source_zh: 请教，这责任如何负法？”
pairs.source_en: May I ask how?”
pairs.zh: 请教，这责任如何负法？”
pairs.en: May I ask how?”

pairs.source_zh: “本年漕运虽由我主管，但自从大人到任，凡事亦曾禀命而行。
pairs.source_en: “Although I have supervised this year's grain transport, since Your Excellency arrived I have acted only after reporting to you.
pairs.zh: “本年漕运虽由我主管，但自从大人到任，凡事亦曾禀命而行。
pairs.en: “Although I have supervised this year's grain transport, since Your Excellency arrived I have acted only after reporting to you.

pairs.source_zh: 今年江苏试办海运，成效甚佳，
pairs.source_en: Jiangsu's trial of sea transport has been highly successful this year.

pairs.source_zh: 请大人出奏，明年浙省仿照江苏成例，不就行了吗？“
pairs.source_en: If Your Excellency requests permission for Zhejiang to follow its example next year, would that not settle the matter?”
pairs.zh: 请大人出奏，明年浙省仿照江苏成例，不就行了吗？“
pairs.en: If Your Excellency requests permission for Zhejiang to follow its example next year, would that not settle the matter?”

pairs.source_en: “Hmph! Hmph!”
pairs.en: “Hmph! Hmph!”

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉不断冷笑，
pairs.source_en: Huang kept giving cold little laughs.

pairs.source_zh: “看贵司的话，好象军机大臣的口吻，
pairs.source_en: “You speak as though you were a grand councillor.

pairs.en: “You speak as though you were a grand councillor.

pairs.source_zh: 我倒再要请教，如果上头不准呢？”
pairs.source_en: Then let me ask another question: what if the throne refuses?”

pairs.en: Then let me ask another question: what if the throne refuses?”

pairs.source_zh: “没有不准之理。”
pairs.source_en: “There is no reason it should refuse.”
pairs.zh: “没有不准之理。”
pairs.en: “There is no reason it should refuse.”

pairs.source_zh: “又是这样的口吻！”
pairs.source_en: “That tone again!”
pairs.zh: “又是这样的口吻！”
pairs.en: “That tone again!”

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉一拍炕几，大声呵斥，“你到底是来议事，还是来抬杠？”
pairs.source_en: Huang struck the small table on the couch and shouted, “Have you come to discuss business or to argue with me?”
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉一拍炕几，大声呵斥，“你到底是来议事，还是来抬杠？”
pairs.en: Huang struck the small table on the couch and shouted, “Have you come to discuss business or to argue with me?”

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿做了二十几年的官，从未见过这样的上司，
pairs.source_en: In more than twenty years of official service, Chunshou had never encountered such a superior.
pairs.zh: 椿寿做了二十几年的官，从未见过这样的上司，
pairs.en: In more than twenty years of official service, Chunshou had never encountered such a superior.

pairs.source_zh: 心里在想：你是科甲出身，我亦不是捐班佐杂爬上来的，受惯了气的，
pairs.source_en: You entered through the examinations, he thought, but I am not some subordinate who bought his way in and has grown accustomed to being insulted.

pairs.en: You entered through the examinations, he thought, but I am not some subordinate who bought his way in and has grown accustomed to being insulted.

pairs.source_zh: 论宦途经历，我放浙江藩司，你还不过是浙江臬司，
pairs.source_en: As for our careers, when I was appointed provincial treasurer of Zhejiang, you were still only its judicial commissioner.
pairs.zh: 论宦途经历，我放浙江藩司，你还不过是浙江臬司，
pairs.en: As for our careers, when I was appointed provincial treasurer of Zhejiang, you were still only its judicial commissioner.

pairs.source_zh: 只不过朝中有人，道光十五年乙未那一榜……
pairs.source_en: You merely have people at court—the men from that yiwei examination of the fifteenth year of Daoguang...
pairs.zh: 只不过朝中有人，道光十五年乙未那一榜……
pairs.en: You merely have people at court—the men from that yiwei examination of the fifteenth year of Daoguang...

pairs.source_zh: 转念到此，椿寿打了个寒噤，暗叫一声：大事不好！
pairs.source_en: At that thought, Chunshou shuddered. This was serious!

pairs.en: At that thought, Chunshou shuddered. This was serious!

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉的同年，已有当了军机大臣的，那是苏州的彭蕴章。
pairs.source_en: One of Huang's examination classmates, Peng Yunzhang of Suzhou, had already become a grand councillor.

pairs.en: One of Huang's examination classmates, Peng Yunzhang of Suzhou, had already become a grand councillor.

pairs.source_zh: 还有户部两侍郎，

pairs.source_zh: 一个是福建的王庆云，最爱照应同乡，
pairs.source_en: One, Wang Qingyun of Fujian, was particularly eager to help men from his home province.
pairs.zh: 一个是福建的王庆云，最爱照应同乡，
pairs.en: One, Wang Qingyun of Fujian, was particularly eager to help men from his home province.

pairs.source_zh: 另一个又是他的同年，而且是好友的伺桂清。

pairs.zh: 另一个又是他的同年，而且是好友的伺桂清。
pairs.en: The other was He Guiqing, another examination classmate of Huang's and a close friend.

pairs.source_zh: 俗语说得好，“朝里无人莫做官。”
pairs.source_en: The saying was true: “Without someone at court, do not seek office.”
pairs.zh: 俗语说得好，“朝里无人莫做官。”
pairs.en: The saying was true: “Without someone at court, do not seek office.”

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉敢于如此目中无人，无非仗着内有奥援，
pairs.source_en: Huang's arrogance rested on powerful backing in the capital.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉敢于如此目中无人，无非仗着内有奥援，
pairs.en: Huang's arrogance rested on powerful backing in the capital.

pairs.source_zh: 而且听说他今年进京，皇上召见六次之多，
