pairs.zh: 而且听说他今年进京，皇上召见六次之多，
pairs.en: Moreover, it was said that during his visit there that year the emperor had received him no fewer than six times.

pairs.source_zh: 圣眷正隆，
pairs.source_en: He was enjoying exceptional imperial favour.
pairs.zh: 圣眷正隆，
pairs.en: He was enjoying exceptional imperial favour.

pairs.source_zh: 自己无论如何碰不过他。
pairs.source_en: Chunshou could not possibly prevail against him.
pairs.zh: 自己无论如何碰不过他。
pairs.en: Chunshou could not possibly prevail against him.

pairs.source_zh: 这些念头雷轰电掣般闪过心头，顿感气馁，
pairs.source_en: These thoughts flashed through his mind like thunder and lightning, draining his courage.
pairs.zh: 这些念头雷轰电掣般闪过心头，顿感气馁，
pairs.en: These thoughts flashed through his mind like thunder and lightning, draining his courage.

pairs.source_zh: 只得忍气吞声地陪个罪。
pairs.source_en: Swallowing his anger, he could only apologise.
pairs.zh: 只得忍气吞声地陪个罪。
pairs.en: Swallowing his anger, he could only apologise.

pairs.source_zh: “大人息怒。
pairs.source_en: “Please do not be angry, Your Excellency.
pairs.zh: “大人息怒。
pairs.en: “Please do not be angry, Your Excellency.

pairs.source_zh: 我岂敢跟大人抬杠？
pairs.source_en: How could I dare argue with you?
pairs.zh: 我岂敢跟大人抬杠？
pairs.en: How could I dare argue with you?

pairs.source_zh: 一切还求大人维持。”
pairs.source_en: I can only ask for your protection in this matter.”
pairs.zh: 一切还求大人维持。”
pairs.en: I can only ask for your protection in this matter.”

pairs.source_zh: 这一说，黄宗汉的脸色才和缓了一些，
pairs.source_en: Only then did Huang's expression soften a little.
pairs.zh: 这一说，黄宗汉的脸色才和缓了一些，
pairs.en: Only then did Huang's expression soften a little.

pairs.source_zh: “既为同僚，
pairs.source_en: “We are colleagues.
pairs.zh: “既为同僚，
pairs.en: “We are colleagues.

pairs.source_zh: 能维持总要维持。
pairs.source_en: Naturally, I shall support you wherever I can.
pairs.zh: 能维持总要维持。
pairs.en: Naturally, I shall support you wherever I can.

pairs.source_zh: 不过，“他使劲摇着头，一字一句地说：”难，难！“
pairs.source_en: But...” He shook his head emphatically and pronounced each word with care. “Difficult. Very difficult.”
pairs.zh: 不过，“他使劲摇着头，一字一句地说：”难，难！“
pairs.en: But...” He shook his head emphatically and pronounced each word with care. “Difficult. Very difficult.”

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿的心越发往下沉，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou's heart sank further.
pairs.zh: 椿寿的心越发往下沉，
pairs.en: Chunshou's heart sank further.

pairs.source_zh: 强自镇静着问道：“大人有何高见？
pairs.source_en: Forcing himself to remain calm, he asked, “What course would Your Excellency advise?
pairs.zh: 强自镇静着问道：“大人有何高见？
pairs.en: Forcing himself to remain calm, he asked, “What course would Your Excellency advise?

pairs.source_zh: 要请教诲。”
pairs.source_en: I beg you to instruct me.”
pairs.zh: 要请教诲。”
pairs.en: I beg you to instruct me.”

pairs.source_zh: “岂敢，岂敢。
pairs.source_en: “Oh, I could hardly presume.
pairs.zh: “岂敢，岂敢。
pairs.en: “Oh, I could hardly presume.

pairs.source_zh: 等我想一想再说吧！”
pairs.source_en: Let me think it over first.”
pairs.zh: 等我想一想再说吧！”
pairs.en: Let me think it over first.”

pairs.source_zh: 说完，端一端茶碗，
pairs.source_en: With that, Huang lifted his teacup.
pairs.zh: 说完，端一端茶碗，
pairs.en: With that, Huang lifted his teacup.

pairs.source_zh: 堂下侍候的戈什哈便拉开嗓子：“送客！”
pairs.source_en: An attendant waiting below called out loudly, “Show the guest out!”
pairs.zh: 堂下侍候的戈什哈便拉开嗓子：“送客！”
pairs.en: An attendant waiting below called out loudly, “Show the guest out!”

pairs.source_zh: 这送客等于逐客。
pairs.source_en: This dismissal amounted to an expulsion.
pairs.zh: 这送客等于逐客。
pairs.en: This dismissal amounted to an expulsion.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿出了抚台衙门，坐在轿子里，只催轿扶加快，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou left the governor's office and, once in his sedan chair, kept urging the bearers to go faster.
pairs.zh: 椿寿出了抚台衙门，坐在轿子里，只催轿扶加快，
pairs.en: Chunshou left the governor's office and, once in his sedan chair, kept urging the bearers to go faster.

pairs.source_zh: 急急赶回本衙门，让听差把文案请到“签押房”，关上房门，
pairs.source_en: Back at his own headquarters, he summoned his secretaries to his private office and shut the door.
pairs.zh: 急急赶回本衙门，让听差把文案请到“签押房”，关上房门，
pairs.en: Back at his own headquarters, he summoned his secretaries to his private office and shut the door.

pairs.source_zh: 细说了上院的经过，惊疑不定地问道：“各位看看，黄抚台这是什么意思？”
pairs.source_en: After describing the interview in detail, he asked in alarm and uncertainty, “What do you think Governor Huang means by all this?”
pairs.zh: 细说了上院的经过，惊疑不定地问道：“各位看看，黄抚台这是什么意思？”
pairs.en: After describing the interview in detail, he asked in alarm and uncertainty, “What do you think Governor Huang means by all this?”

pairs.source_zh: “黄抚台外号‘黄阎罗’，
pairs.source_en: “His nickname is Huang the King of Hell.
pairs.zh: “黄抚台外号‘黄阎罗’，
pairs.en: “His nickname is Huang the King of Hell.

pairs.source_zh: 翻脸不认人是出名的，
pairs.source_en: He is notorious for turning on people without warning.
pairs.zh: 翻脸不认人是出名的，
pairs.en: He is notorious for turning on people without warning.

pairs.source_zh: 这件事要好好铺排一下。”
pairs.source_en: This business will need careful handling.”
pairs.zh: 这件事要好好铺排一下。”
pairs.en: This business will need careful handling.”

pairs.source_en: “Ah!”
pairs.en: “Ah!”

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿摇摇头，欲言又止，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou shook his head, beginning to speak and then stopping.
pairs.zh: 椿寿摇摇头，欲言又止，
pairs.en: Chunshou shook his head, beginning to speak and then stopping.

pairs.source_zh: 失悔在黄抚台刚到任，不理他索贿的暗示。
pairs.source_en: He regretted having ignored Huang's hint about a bribe when the new governor first arrived.
pairs.zh: 失悔在黄抚台刚到任，不理他索贿的暗示。
pairs.en: He regretted having ignored Huang's hint about a bribe when the new governor first arrived.

pairs.source_zh: “ ‘天大的公事，地大的银子’，”有个文案说很很率直，
pairs.source_en: “‘A mountain of official business can be moved by a mountain of silver,’” one secretary said bluntly.
pairs.zh: “ ‘天大的公事，地大的银子’，”有个文案说很很率直，
pairs.en: “‘A mountain of official business can be moved by a mountain of silver,’” one secretary said bluntly.

pairs.source_zh: “先去探探口气看，院上到底打的什么主意？”
pairs.source_en: “We should first sound him out and learn what he really has in mind.”
pairs.zh: “先去探探口气看，院上到底打的什么主意？”
pairs.en: “We should first sound him out and learn what he really has in mind.”

pairs.source_zh: 于是连夜走路子去打听，总算有了确实的消息，
pairs.source_en: They used their connections that very night to make inquiries and eventually obtained definite news.
pairs.zh: 于是连夜走路子去打听，总算有了确实的消息，
pairs.en: They used their connections that very night to make inquiries and eventually obtained definite news.

pairs.source_zh: 据说黄宗汉为了明年的新漕得以早日受兑装载，照限期抵达通州，决定上奏，把湖属八帮的瘤船追了回来，
pairs.source_en: It was said that, to ensure next year's new grain could be accepted and loaded early and reach Tongzhou on time, Huang had decided to petition the throne to recall the boats of Huzhou's eight associations.
pairs.zh: 据说黄宗汉为了明年的新漕得以早日受兑装载，照限期抵达通州，决定上奏，把湖属八帮的瘤船追了回来，
pairs.en: It was said that, to ensure next year's new grain could be accepted and loaded early and reach Tongzhou on time, Huang had decided to petition the throne to recall the boats of Huzhou's eight associations.

pairs.source_zh: 漕米卸岸入仓，连同明年的新漕，一起装运。
pairs.source_en: Their grain would be unloaded and stored, then shipped together with next year's collection.
pairs.zh: 漕米卸岸入仓，连同明年的新漕，一起装运。
pairs.en: Their grain would be unloaded and stored, then shipped together with next year's collection.

pairs.source_zh: 这样做法，只苦了漕帮，白白赔上一笔疏浚河道的费用。
pairs.source_en: Such a measure would chiefly hurt the associations, which would have paid for the dredging to no purpose.
pairs.zh: 这样做法，只苦了漕帮，白白赔上一笔疏浚河道的费用。
pairs.en: Such a measure would chiefly hurt the associations, which would have paid for the dredging to no purpose.

pairs.source_zh: 其次，那些奉委押运的候补州县，没有“公费”可派，一笔过年的盘缠便落空了。
pairs.source_en: The expectant magistrates appointed as escorts would suffer too: without official expense allowances to draw upon, the money they had hoped to take home for the New Year would vanish.
pairs.zh: 其次，那些奉委押运的候补州县，没有“公费”可派，一笔过年的盘缠便落空了。
pairs.en: The expectant magistrates appointed as escorts would suffer too: without official expense allowances to draw upon, the money they had hoped to take home for the New Year would vanish.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿心中虽有不忍，但到底是别人的事，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou felt sorry for them, but their troubles were, after all, their own.
pairs.zh: 椿寿心中虽有不忍，但到底是别人的事，
pairs.en: Chunshou felt sorry for them, but their troubles were, after all, their own.

pairs.source_zh: 藩司能够不赔，已是上上大吉，
pairs.source_en: If the provincial treasury could escape a loss, that was already the best he could hope for.
pairs.zh: 藩司能够不赔，已是上上大吉，
pairs.en: If the provincial treasury could escape a loss, that was already the best he could hope for.

pairs.source_zh: 只好狠一狠心不理他们了。
pairs.source_en: He would have to harden his heart and leave them to it.
pairs.zh: 只好狠一狠心不理他们了。
pairs.en: He would have to harden his heart and leave them to it.

pairs.source_zh: 果然，第二天抚台衙门来了正式公事，
pairs.source_en: Sure enough, an official order arrived from the governor's office the next day.
pairs.zh: 果然，第二天抚台衙门来了正式公事，
pairs.en: Sure enough, an official order arrived from the governor's office the next day.

pairs.source_zh: 惟恐影响来年新漕的期限，“所有本年湖属八帮漕船，仰该司即便遵照，全数追回，候命办理。”
pairs.source_en: To avoid disrupting the schedule for the following year's grain, “all boats belonging to this year's eight Huzhou associations are to be recalled without delay, in full compliance with this order, and held pending further instructions.”
pairs.zh: 惟恐影响来年新漕的期限，“所有本年湖属八帮漕船，仰该司即便遵照，全数追回，候命办理。”
pairs.en: To avoid disrupting the schedule for the following year's grain, “all boats belonging to this year's eight Huzhou associations are to be recalled without delay, in full compliance with this order, and held pending further instructions.”

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿不敢怠慢，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou dared not hesitate.
pairs.zh: 椿寿不敢怠慢，
pairs.en: Chunshou dared not hesitate.

pairs.source_zh: 立即派出人去，把湖属八帮的漕船截了回来，同时上院去见抚台，请示所谓“候命办理”是如何办法？
pairs.source_en: He immediately sent men to intercept the boats and bring them back, then went to the governor's office to ask what the “further instructions” would be.
pairs.zh: 立即派出人去，把湖属八帮的漕船截了回来，同时上院去见抚台，请示所谓“候命办理”是如何办法？
pairs.en: He immediately sent men to intercept the boats and bring them back, then went to the governor's office to ask what the “further instructions” would be.

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉一直托病不见。
pairs.source_en: Huang repeatedly declined to see him, pleading illness.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉一直托病不见。
pairs.en: Huang repeatedly declined to see him, pleading illness.

pairs.source_zh: 过了有五、六天，一角公文送到，
pairs.source_en: Five or six days later, another official dispatch arrived.
pairs.zh: 过了有五、六天，一角公文送到，
pairs.en: Five or six days later, another official dispatch arrived.

pairs.source_zh: 拆开一看，椿寿几乎昏厥，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou opened it and almost fainted.
pairs.zh: 拆开一看，椿寿几乎昏厥，
pairs.en: Chunshou opened it and almost fainted.

pairs.source_zh: 顿足骂道，“黄寿臣，黄寿臣，你好狠的心！
pairs.source_en: Stamping his foot, he cried, “Huang Shouchen! Huang Shouchen! How can you be so cruel?
pairs.zh: 顿足骂道，“黄寿臣，黄寿臣，你好狠的心！
pairs.en: Stamping his foot, he cried, “Huang Shouchen! Huang Shouchen! How can you be so cruel?

pairs.source_zh: 我与你问冤何仇，你要置我于死地！“
pairs.source_en: What wrong have I done you that you must drive me to my death?”
pairs.zh: 我与你问冤何仇，你要置我于死地！“
pairs.en: What wrong have I done you that you must drive me to my death?”

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉的手段，的确太毒辣了，
pairs.source_en: Huang's methods were indeed ruthless.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉的手段，的确太毒辣了，
pairs.en: Huang's methods were indeed ruthless.

pairs.source_zh: 他以一省最高行政长官的地位，统筹漕运全局的理由，为了使来年新漕的输运，如期完成，以期此后各年均得恢复正常，作了一个决定，本年湖属八帮的漕米，留浙变价，
pairs.source_en: Invoking his authority as the province's highest administrative official and his responsibility for the entire grain-transport system, he had issued a decision. To ensure that the following year's grain arrived on schedule and that regular arrangements could thereafter be restored, this year's grain from Huzhou's eight associations would remain in Zhejiang and be sold.
pairs.zh: 他以一省最高行政长官的地位，统筹漕运全局的理由，为了使来年新漕的输运，如期完成，以期此后各年均得恢复正常，作了一个决定，本年湖属八帮的漕米，留浙变价，
pairs.en: Invoking his authority as the province's highest administrative official and his responsibility for the entire grain-transport system, he had issued a decision. To ensure that the following year's grain arrived on schedule and that regular arrangements could thereafter be restored, this year's grain from Huzhou's eight associations would remain in Zhejiang and be sold.

pairs.source_zh: 全部漕米二十七万六千石，
pairs.source_en: The total quantity was 276,000 shi.
pairs.zh: 全部漕米二十七万六千石，
pairs.en: The total quantity was 276,000 shi.

pairs.source_zh: 照户部所定价格，每石二两银子，共该五十五万二千两，限期一个月报缴。
pairs.source_en: At the Board of Revenue's prescribed rate of two taels per shi, the proceeds due were 552,000 taels, to be remitted within one month.
pairs.zh: 照户部所定价格，每石二两银子，共该五十五万二千两，限期一个月报缴。
pairs.en: At the Board of Revenue's prescribed rate of two taels per shi, the proceeds due were 552,000 taels, to be remitted within one month.

pairs.source_zh: 这是椿寿与尖丁早已算过了的，市价与部价的差额，一共要三十三万两银子。
pairs.source_en: Chunshou and the headman had already worked out what this meant: the gap between the market price and the official rate was some 330,000 taels.
pairs.zh: 这是椿寿与尖丁早已算过了的，市价与部价的差额，一共要三十三万两银子。
pairs.en: Chunshou and the headman had already worked out what this meant: the gap between the market price and the official rate was some 330,000 taels.

pairs.source_zh: 如果在他第一次到湖州开会之前，抚台就作了这个决定，那么漕帮赔大部分，藩司赔小部分，
pairs.source_en: Had the governor made this decision before Chunshou's first meeting in Huzhou, the associations would have borne the larger share and the provincial treasury the smaller.
pairs.zh: 如果在他第一次到湖州开会之前，抚台就作了这个决定，那么漕帮赔大部分，藩司赔小部分，
pairs.en: Had the governor made this decision before Chunshou's first meeting in Huzhou, the associations would have borne the larger share and the provincial treasury the smaller.

pairs.source_zh: 这笔小部分的赔款，也还可以在浮收的款项中拨付，
pairs.source_en: The treasury's portion could still have been drawn from the excess collections.
pairs.zh: 这笔小部分的赔款，也还可以在浮收的款项中拨付，
pairs.en: The treasury's portion could still have been drawn from the excess collections.

pairs.source_zh: 说起来只是今年白吃一场辛苦，没有“好处”而已。
pairs.source_en: In effect, everyone would merely have worked for nothing that year and forfeited their customary gains.
pairs.zh: 说起来只是今年白吃一场辛苦，没有“好处”而已。
pairs.en: In effect, everyone would merely have worked for nothing that year and forfeited their customary gains.

pairs.source_zh: 但现在的情况完全不同了，
pairs.source_en: Now the situation was entirely different.
pairs.zh: 但现在的情况完全不同了，
pairs.en: Now the situation was entirely different.

pairs.source_zh: 漕帮负担了疏浚河道的全部经费，事先已经声明，出了这笔钱，漕船非走不可，
pairs.source_en: The associations had paid the full cost of dredging and had explicitly stipulated that, once the money was spent, the boats must sail.
pairs.zh: 漕帮负担了疏浚河道的全部经费，事先已经声明，出了这笔钱，漕船非走不可，
pairs.en: The associations had paid the full cost of dredging and had explicitly stipulated that, once the money was spent, the boats must sail.

pairs.source_zh: 于今截回不定，已觉愧对漕帮，
pairs.source_en: Recalling them already left Chunshou ashamed.
pairs.zh: 于今截回不定，已觉愧对漕帮，
pairs.en: Recalling them already left Chunshou ashamed.

pairs.source_zh: 再要他们分赔差额，就是漕帮肯赔，自己也难启齿，何况看情形是决无此可能的。
pairs.source_en: He could hardly ask them to contribute towards the price shortfall as well, even if they were willing—which, from all appearances, they certainly were not.
pairs.zh: 再要他们分赔差额，就是漕帮肯赔，自己也难启齿，何况看情形是决无此可能的。
pairs.en: He could hardly ask them to contribute towards the price shortfall as well, even if they were willing—which, from all appearances, they certainly were not.

pairs.source_zh: 至于浮收的“好处”，早已按股照派，“分润”有夫人员，
pairs.source_en: As for the profits from excess collection, those had already been divided into shares and distributed among the people concerned.
pairs.zh: 至于浮收的“好处”，早已按股照派，“分润”有夫人员，
pairs.en: As for the profits from excess collection, those had already been divided into shares and distributed among the people concerned.

pairs.source_zh: 哪里再去追索？
pairs.source_en: How could they now be recovered?
pairs.zh: 哪里再去追索？
pairs.en: How could they now be recovered?

pairs.source_zh: 即使追索得到，也不过五、六万银子，还差着一大截呢！
pairs.source_en: Even if recovery were possible, they amounted to only fifty or sixty thousand taels, far short of what was needed.
pairs.zh: 即使追索得到，也不过五、六万银子，还差着一大截呢！
pairs.en: Even if recovery were possible, they amounted to only fifty or sixty thousand taels, far short of what was needed.

pairs.source_zh: 事情的演变，竟会弄得全部责任，落在自己一个人头上。
pairs.source_en: Events had somehow left the entire burden resting on Chunshou alone.
pairs.zh: 事情的演变，竟会弄得全部责任，落在自己一个人头上。
pairs.en: Events had somehow left the entire burden resting on Chunshou alone.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿悔恨交并，而仍不能不拼命作最后的挣扎，
pairs.source_en: Tormented by regret and anger, he nevertheless had to make one last desperate effort.
pairs.zh: 椿寿悔恨交并，而仍不能不拼命作最后的挣扎，
pairs.en: Tormented by regret and anger, he nevertheless had to make one last desperate effort.

pairs.source_zh: 愁眉苦脸地召集了亲信来商议，
pairs.source_en: With a miserable expression, he called his trusted advisers together.
pairs.zh: 愁眉苦脸地召集了亲信来商议，
pairs.en: With a miserable expression, he called his trusted advisers together.

pairs.source_zh: 大家一致的看法是：“解铃还须系铃人”，
pairs.source_en: They all reached the same conclusion: only the man who had tied the knot could untie it.
pairs.zh: 大家一致的看法是：“解铃还须系铃人”，
pairs.en: They all reached the same conclusion: only the man who had tied the knot could untie it.

pairs.source_zh: 惟有去求抚台，收回“变价”的成命，应解的二十多万石漕米，随明年新漕一起启运。
pairs.source_en: He must beg the governor to withdraw the order to sell the grain and allow the more than two hundred thousand shi to be shipped with the next year's collection.
pairs.zh: 惟有去求抚台，收回“变价”的成命，应解的二十多万石漕米，随明年新漕一起启运。
pairs.en: He must beg the governor to withdraw the order to sell the grain and allow the more than two hundred thousand shi to be shipped with the next year's collection.

pairs.source_zh: 就这样起卸入仓，从船上搬到岸上，明年再从岸上搬到船上，来回周折的运费、仓费，以及两次搬动的损耗，算起来也要赔好几万两银子，
pairs.source_en: Unloading it now, storing it on shore, and loading it again the following year would still cost tens of thousands of taels in handling charges, storage fees, and losses from repeated movement.
pairs.zh: 就这样起卸入仓，从船上搬到岸上，明年再从岸上搬到船上，来回周折的运费、仓费，以及两次搬动的损耗，算起来也要赔好几万两银子，
pairs.en: Unloading it now, storing it on shore, and loading it again the following year would still cost tens of thousands of taels in handling charges, storage fees, and losses from repeated movement.

pairs.source_zh: 而且一定还会受到处分，
pairs.source_en: A disciplinary penalty would also be unavoidable.
pairs.zh: 而且一定还会受到处分，
pairs.en: A disciplinary penalty would also be unavoidable.

pairs.source_zh: 但无论如何总比赔三十三万两银子来得好。
pairs.source_en: Even so, it would be better than finding 330,000 taels.
pairs.zh: 但无论如何总比赔三十三万两银子来得好。
pairs.en: Even so, it would be better than finding 330,000 taels.

pairs.source_zh: 两害相权取其轻，椿寿只得硬着头皮上院，
pairs.source_en: Choosing the lesser of two evils, Chunshou steeled himself and went to the governor's office.
pairs.zh: 两害相权取其轻，椿寿只得硬着头皮上院，
pairs.en: Choosing the lesser of two evils, Chunshou steeled himself and went to the governor's office.

pairs.source_zh: 把“手本”送了进去，门上出来答道：
pairs.source_en: He sent in his visiting card, but the gatekeeper returned with a message.
pairs.zh: 把“手本”送了进去，门上出来答道：
pairs.en: He sent in his visiting card, but the gatekeeper returned with a message.

pairs.source_zh: “上头人不舒服，请大人回去吧！
pairs.source_en: “His Excellency is unwell and asks you to go home.
pairs.zh: “上头人不舒服，请大人回去吧！
pairs.en: “His Excellency is unwell and asks you to go home.

pairs.source_zh: 上头交代，等病好了，再请大人过来相叙。”
pairs.source_en: He says he will invite you to call when he has recovered.”
pairs.zh: 上头交代，等病好了，再请大人过来相叙。”
pairs.en: He says he will invite you to call when he has recovered.”

pairs.source_zh: 棒寿愤不可遏，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou's anger became uncontrollable.
pairs.zh: 棒寿愤不可遏，
pairs.en: Chunshou's anger became uncontrollable.

pairs.source_zh: 吩咐跟班说：“回去取铺盖！
pairs.source_en: “Go back and fetch my bedding,” he told his attendant.
pairs.zh: 吩咐跟班说：“回去取铺盖！
pairs.en: “Go back and fetch my bedding,” he told his attendant.

pairs.source_zh: 抚台不见我不走，
pairs.source_en: “If the governor will not see me, I shall not leave.
pairs.zh: 抚台不见我不走，
pairs.en: “If the governor will not see me, I shall not leave.

pairs.source_zh: 就借官厅的炕床睡。”
pairs.source_en: I can sleep on the couch in the reception hall.”
pairs.zh: 就借官厅的炕床睡。”
pairs.en: I can sleep on the couch in the reception hall.”

pairs.source_zh: 门上一看，这不象话，赶紧陪笑道：
pairs.source_en: Seeing how unseemly the situation was becoming, the gatekeeper hastened to placate him.
pairs.zh: 门上一看，这不象话，赶紧陪笑道：
pairs.en: Seeing how unseemly the situation was becoming, the gatekeeper hastened to placate him.

pairs.source_zh: “大人不必，不必！
pairs.source_en: “There is no need, Your Excellency, no need at all!
pairs.zh: “大人不必，不必！
pairs.en: “There is no need, Your Excellency, no need at all!

pairs.source_zh: 想来是有急要公事要回，
pairs.source_en: You must have some urgent official matter to report.
pairs.zh: 想来是有急要公事要回，
pairs.en: You must have some urgent official matter to report.

pairs.source_zh: 我再到上房去跑一趟。”
pairs.source_en: I shall go to the inner quarters once more.”
pairs.zh: 我再到上房去跑一趟。”
pairs.en: I shall go to the inner quarters once more.”

pairs.source_zh: 于是椿寿就在官厅中坐等，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou waited in the reception hall.
pairs.zh: 于是椿寿就在官厅中坐等，
pairs.en: Chunshou waited in the reception hall.

pairs.source_zh: 等了半个时辰，黄宗汉出来了，仰着头，板着脸，
pairs.source_en: After about an hour, Huang appeared, head raised and face stern.
pairs.zh: 等了半个时辰，黄宗汉出来了，仰着头，板着脸，
pairs.en: After about an hour, Huang appeared, head raised and face stern.

pairs.source_zh: 一见面不等椿寿开口，就先大声问道：“你非见我不可？”
pairs.source_en: Before Chunshou could speak, he demanded loudly, “You insist on seeing me?”
pairs.zh: 一见面不等椿寿开口，就先大声问道：“你非见我不可？”
pairs.en: Before Chunshou could speak, he demanded loudly, “You insist on seeing me?”

pairs.source_zh: “是！”椿寿低声下气地回答：
pairs.source_en: “Yes,” Chunshou replied humbly.
pairs.zh: “是！”椿寿低声下气地回答：
pairs.en: “Yes,” Chunshou replied humbly.

pairs.source_zh: “大人贵恙在身，本不该打搅，只是实在有万分困难的下情上禀。”
pairs.source_en: “I ought not to disturb Your Excellency during your illness, but I am in the greatest difficulty and must explain my circumstances.”
pairs.zh: “大人贵恙在身，本不该打搅，只是实在有万分困难的下情上禀。”
pairs.en: “I ought not to disturb Your Excellency during your illness, but I am in the greatest difficulty and must explain my circumstances.”

pairs.source_zh: “如果是湖属漕米的事，你不必谈。
pairs.source_en: “If it concerns the Huzhou grain, there is no need to say anything.
pairs.zh: “如果是湖属漕米的事，你不必谈。
pairs.en: “If it concerns the Huzhou grain, there is no need to say anything.

pairs.source_zh: 已经出奏了。”
pairs.source_en: I have already reported the decision to the throne.”
pairs.zh: 已经出奏了。”
pairs.en: I have already reported the decision to the throne.”

pairs.source_zh: 这句话就如焦雷轰顶，
pairs.source_en: The words struck him like a thunderbolt.
pairs.zh: 这句话就如焦雷轰顶，
pairs.en: The words struck him like a thunderbolt.

pairs.source_zh: 一时天旋地转，不得不颓然坐倒，
pairs.source_en: The room seemed to spin, and he collapsed into a seat.
pairs.zh: 一时天旋地转，不得不颓然坐倒，
pairs.en: The room seemed to spin, and he collapsed into a seat.

pairs.source_zh: 等定定神看时，黄宗汉已无踪影，
pairs.source_en: When he recovered enough to look around, Huang had vanished.
pairs.zh: 等定定神看时，黄宗汉已无踪影，
pairs.en: When he recovered enough to look around, Huang had vanished.

pairs.source_zh: 抚院的戈什哈低声向他说道：“大人请回吧！
pairs.source_en: An attendant said softly, “Please go home, Your Excellency.
pairs.zh: 抚院的戈什哈低声向他说道：“大人请回吧！
pairs.en: An attendant said softly, “Please go home, Your Excellency.

pairs.source_zh: 轿子已经伺侯半天了。”
pairs.source_en: Your chair has been waiting for some time.”
pairs.zh: 轿子已经伺侯半天了。”
pairs.en: Your chair has been waiting for some time.”

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿闭上眼，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou closed his eyes.
pairs.zh: 椿寿闭上眼，
pairs.en: Chunshou closed his eyes.

pairs.source_zh: 眼角流出两滴眼泪，
pairs.source_en: Two tears escaped from their corners.
pairs.zh: 眼角流出两滴眼泪，
pairs.en: Two tears escaped from their corners.

pairs.source_zh: 拿马蹄袖拭一拭干净，由听差扶掖着，一步懒似一步地走官厅。
pairs.source_en: He wiped them away with the curved cuffs of his robe and, supported by an attendant, left the hall, each step more reluctant than the last.
pairs.zh: 拿马蹄袖拭一拭干净，由听差扶掖着，一步懒似一步地走官厅。
pairs.en: He wiped them away with the curved cuffs of his robe and, supported by an attendant, left the hall, each step more reluctant than the last.

pairs.source_zh: 就在这天晚上，椿寿在藩司衙门后院的签押房里，上吊自杀。
pairs.source_en: That night, Chunshou hanged himself in the private office behind the provincial treasury.
pairs.zh: 就在这天晚上，椿寿在藩司衙门后院的签押房里，上吊自杀。
pairs.en: That night, Chunshou hanged himself in the private office behind the provincial treasury.

pairs.source_zh: 第二天一早为家人发觉，哭声震动内外，
pairs.source_en: His household discovered him early the next morning, and their cries of grief filled the compound.
pairs.zh: 第二天一早为家人发觉，哭声震动内外，
pairs.en: His household discovered him early the next morning, and their cries of grief filled the compound.

pairs.source_zh: 少不得有人献殷勤，把这个不幸的消息，飞报抚台。
pairs.source_en: Someone inevitably seized the opportunity to curry favour by rushing the unhappy news to the governor.
pairs.zh: 少不得有人献殷勤，把这个不幸的消息，飞报抚台。
pairs.en: Someone inevitably seized the opportunity to curry favour by rushing the unhappy news to the governor.

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉一听，知道闯了祸，
pairs.source_en: Huang knew at once that he was in trouble.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉一听，知道闯了祸，
pairs.en: Huang knew at once that he was in trouble.

pairs.source_zh: 逼死二品大贝，罪名不轻。
pairs.source_en: Driving an official of the second rank to his death was no minor offence.
pairs.zh: 逼死二品大贝，罪名不轻。
pairs.en: Driving an official of the second rank to his death was no minor offence.

pairs.source_zh: 但转念想起一重公案，
pairs.source_en: Then he remembered an earlier case.
pairs.zh: 但转念想起一重公案，
pairs.en: Then he remembered an earlier case.

pairs.source_zh: 觉得可以如法炮制，
pairs.source_en: If he could follow the same procedure, perhaps he would be safe.
pairs.zh: 觉得可以如法炮制，
pairs.en: If he could follow the same procedure, perhaps he would be safe.

pairs.source_zh: 心便放了一半。
pairs.source_en: The thought eased half his fear.
pairs.zh: 心便放了一半。
pairs.en: The thought eased half his fear.

pairs.source_zh: 他想起的是陕西蒲城王鼎尸谏的往事，这重公案发生在十年以前，
pairs.source_en: The case he recalled was that of Wang Ding of Pucheng, Shaanxi, who had taken his own life as a final remonstrance ten years earlier.
pairs.zh: 他想起的是陕西蒲城王鼎尸谏的往事，这重公案发生在十年以前，
pairs.en: The case he recalled was that of Wang Ding of Pucheng, Shaanxi, who had taken his own life as a final remonstrance ten years earlier.

pairs.source_zh: 王鼎与奸臣穆彰阿，同为大学士值军机。
pairs.source_en: Wang and the corrupt minister Mujangga had both been grand secretaries serving on the Grand Council.
pairs.zh: 王鼎与奸臣穆彰阿，同为大学士值军机。
pairs.en: Wang and the corrupt minister Mujangga had both been grand secretaries serving on the Grand Council.

pairs.source_zh: 这位“蒲城相国”性情刚烈，嫉恶如仇，
pairs.source_en: Wang, known as the grand secretary from Pucheng, was fierce in temperament and hated wrongdoing.
pairs.zh: 这位“蒲城相国”性情刚烈，嫉恶如仇，
pairs.en: Wang, known as the grand secretary from Pucheng, was fierce in temperament and hated wrongdoing.

pairs.source_zh: 而遇到穆彰阿是阴柔奸险的性格，
pairs.source_en: Mujangga was subtle, yielding in manner, and treacherous.
pairs.zh: 而遇到穆彰阿是阴柔奸险的性格，
pairs.en: Mujangga was subtle, yielding in manner, and treacherous.

pairs.source_zh: 每在御前争执，一个声色俱厉，一个从容自如，
pairs.source_en: When they argued before the Daoguang emperor, one spoke with visible anger while the other remained composed.
pairs.zh: 每在御前争执，一个声色俱厉，一个从容自如，
pairs.en: When they argued before the Daoguang emperor, one spoke with visible anger while the other remained composed.

pairs.source_zh: 宣宗偏听不明，总觉得王鼎不免过分。
pairs.source_en: The emperor, swayed by one side and failing to see clearly, invariably felt that Wang had gone too far.
pairs.zh: 宣宗偏听不明，总觉得王鼎不免过分。
pairs.en: The emperor, swayed by one side and failing to see clearly, invariably felt that Wang had gone too far.

pairs.source_zh: 道光二十二年，为了保荐林则徐夏用，王鼎不惜自杀尸谏，遗疏痛劾穆彰阿。
pairs.source_en: In the twenty-second year of Daoguang, Wang Ding pressed for Lin Zexu's restoration to office and went so far as to hang himself in remonstrance, leaving a memorial that bitterly denounced Mujangga.
pairs.zh: 道光二十二年，为了保荐林则徐夏用，王鼎不惜自杀尸谏，遗疏痛劾穆彰阿。
pairs.en: In the twenty-second year of Daoguang, Wang Ding pressed for Lin Zexu's restoration to office and went so far as to hang himself in remonstrance, leaving a memorial that bitterly denounced Mujangga.

pairs.source_zh: 那时有个军机章京叫陈孚恩，是穆彰阿的走狗，一看王鼎不曾入值，亦未请假，
pairs.source_en: A Grand Council secretary named Chen Fu'en, one of Mujangga's henchmen, noticed that Wang had neither attended duty nor asked for leave.
pairs.zh: 那时有个军机章京叫陈孚恩，是穆彰阿的走狗，一看王鼎不曾入值，亦未请假，
pairs.en: A Grand Council secretary named Chen Fu'en, one of Mujangga's henchmen, noticed that Wang had neither attended duty nor asked for leave.

pairs.source_zh: 心里一支，借故出宫，赶到王鼎家一看，
pairs.source_en: Growing suspicious, he found an excuse to leave the palace and hurried to Wang's residence.
pairs.zh: 心里一支，借故出宫，赶到王鼎家一看，
pairs.en: Growing suspicious, he found an excuse to leave the palace and hurried to Wang's residence.

pairs.source_zh: 听得哭声震天，越发有数。
pairs.source_en: The sound of overwhelming grief confirmed his fears.
pairs.zh: 听得哭声震天，越发有数。
pairs.en: The sound of overwhelming grief confirmed his fears.

pairs.source_zh: 趁王鼎的儿子，翰林院编修王抗骤遭大故，五中昏瞀的当儿，劝他把王鼎的尸首解下来，同时把遗疏抓到手里，
pairs.source_en: Wang's son, Wang Kang, a compiler in the Hanlin Academy, was dazed by the sudden calamity. Taking advantage of his confusion, Chen urged him to have the body lowered and at the same time secured the final memorial.
pairs.zh: 趁王鼎的儿子，翰林院编修王抗骤遭大故，五中昏瞀的当儿，劝他把王鼎的尸首解下来，同时把遗疏抓到手里，
pairs.en: Wang's son, Wang Kang, a compiler in the Hanlin Academy, was dazed by the sudden calamity. Taking advantage of his confusion, Chen urged him to have the body lowered and at the same time secured the final memorial.

pairs.source_zh: 一看内容，不出所料，
pairs.source_en: Its contents were exactly what he had expected.
pairs.zh: 一看内容，不出所料，
pairs.en: Its contents were exactly what he had expected.

pairs.source_zh: 便又劝王抗以个人前程为重，不必得罪穆彰阿，
pairs.source_en: He then advised Wang Kang to think of his own future and avoid offending Mujangga.
pairs.zh: 便又劝王抗以个人前程为重，不必得罪穆彰阿，
pairs.en: He then advised Wang Kang to think of his own future and avoid offending Mujangga.

pairs.source_zh: 又说“上头”对王鼎印象不佳，而大臣自杀，有伤国体，
pairs.source_en: He added that the emperor already held a poor opinion of Wang Ding and that a senior minister's suicide damaged the dignity of the state.
pairs.zh: 又说“上头”对王鼎印象不佳，而大臣自杀，有伤国体，
pairs.en: He added that the emperor already held a poor opinion of Wang Ding and that a senior minister's suicide damaged the dignity of the state.

pairs.source_zh: 说不定天颜震怒，不但王鼎身后的恤典落空，而且别有不测之祸。
pairs.source_en: If the emperor became angry, the family might lose not only the customary posthumous honours but also face unforeseen disaster.
pairs.zh: 说不定天颜震怒，不但王鼎身后的恤典落空，而且别有不测之祸。
pairs.en: If the emperor became angry, the family might lose not only the customary posthumous honours but also face unforeseen disaster.

pairs.source_zh: 这一番威胁利诱，教王抗上了当，
pairs.source_en: Threats and promises together deceived Wang Kang.
pairs.zh: 这一番威胁利诱，教王抗上了当，
pairs.en: Threats and promises together deceived Wang Kang.

pairs.source_zh: 听从穆彰阿更改遗疏，并以暴疾身故奏报。
pairs.source_en: He accepted Mujangga's alteration of the final memorial, and his father's death was reported as the result of sudden illness.
pairs.zh: 听从穆彰阿更改遗疏，并以暴疾身故奏报。
pairs.en: He accepted Mujangga's alteration of the final memorial, and his father's death was reported as the result of sudden illness.

pairs.source_zh: 宣宗也有些疑心，但穆彰阿布置周密，“上头”无法获知真相，
pairs.source_en: The Daoguang emperor had some suspicions, but Mujangga had arranged matters so thoroughly that the truth could not reach the throne.
pairs.zh: 宣宗也有些疑心，但穆彰阿布置周密，“上头”无法获知真相，
pairs.en: The Daoguang emperor had some suspicions, but Mujangga had arranged matters so thoroughly that the truth could not reach the throne.

pairs.source_zh: 也就算了。
pairs.source_en: The affair was allowed to rest.
pairs.zh: 也就算了。
pairs.en: The affair was allowed to rest.

pairs.source_zh: 陈孚恩帮了穆彰阿这个大忙，收获也下小，
pairs.source_en: Chen Fu'en profited handsomely from this service.
pairs.zh: 陈孚恩帮了穆彰阿这个大忙，收获也下小，
pairs.en: Chen Fu'en profited handsomely from this service.

pairs.source_zh: 不久，穆彰阿就保他当山东巡抚。
pairs.source_en: Before long, Mujangga recommended him for the governorship of Shandong.
pairs.zh: 不久，穆彰阿就保他当山东巡抚。
pairs.en: Before long, Mujangga recommended him for the governorship of Shandong.

pairs.source_zh: 而王抗则以不能成父之志，为他父亲的门生，他自己的同年，以及陕甘同乡所不齿，
pairs.source_en: Wang Kang, on the other hand, was despised for failing to fulfil his father's purpose—by his father's protégés, by his own examination classmates, and by fellow natives of Shaanxi and Gansu.
pairs.zh: 而王抗则以不能成父之志，为他父亲的门生，他自己的同年，以及陕甘同乡所不齿，
pairs.en: Wang Kang, on the other hand, was despised for failing to fulfil his father's purpose—by his father's protégés, by his own examination classmates, and by fellow natives of Shaanxi and Gansu.

pairs.source_zh: 辞官回里，郁郁以终。
pairs.source_en: He resigned, returned home, and died in sorrow.
pairs.zh: 辞官回里，郁郁以终。
pairs.en: He resigned, returned home, and died in sorrow.

pairs.source_zh: 穆彰阿是道光十五年乙未科会试的大主考，
pairs.source_en: Mujangga had been chief examiner at the metropolitan examination in the yiwei year, the fifteenth year of Daoguang.
pairs.zh: 穆彰阿是道光十五年乙未科会试的大主考，
pairs.en: Mujangga had been chief examiner at the metropolitan examination in the yiwei year, the fifteenth year of Daoguang.

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉是他的门生，颇为巴结这位老师。
pairs.source_en: Huang Zonghan was therefore one of his examination protégés and had diligently cultivated his patron.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉是他的门生，颇为巴结这位老师。
pairs.en: Huang Zonghan was therefore one of his examination protégés and had diligently cultivated his patron.

pairs.source_zh: 秦桧门下有“十客”，穆彰阿门下有“十子”，
pairs.source_en: Just as Qin Hui had once had his “Ten Guests,” Mujangga had his “Ten Sons.”
pairs.zh: 秦桧门下有“十客”，穆彰阿门下有“十子”，
pairs.en: Just as Qin Hui had once had his “Ten Guests,” Mujangga had his “Ten Sons.”

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉与陈孚恩都在“穆门十子”之数，自然熟知其事。
pairs.source_en: Huang and Chen Fu'en both belonged to that circle, so Huang knew the Wang Ding affair very well.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉与陈孚恩都在“穆门十子”之数，自然熟知其事。
pairs.en: Huang and Chen Fu'en both belonged to that circle, so Huang knew the Wang Ding affair very well.

pairs.source_zh: 所以，一遇椿寿的变故，他立即遣派亲信，以釜底抽薪的宗旨，先设法把椿寿的遗嘱弄到手，
pairs.source_en: As soon as Chunshou's death occurred, he sent trusted men to secure Chunshou's final statement, aiming to remove the danger at its source.
pairs.zh: 所以，一遇椿寿的变故，他立即遣派亲信，以釜底抽薪的宗旨，先设法把椿寿的遗嘱弄到手，
pairs.en: As soon as Chunshou's death occurred, he sent trusted men to secure Chunshou's final statement, aiming to remove the danger at its source.

pairs.source_zh: 然后亲自拜访驻防的将军和浙江学政，
pairs.source_en: He then personally visited the commander of the local banner garrison and Zhejiang's education commissioner.
pairs.zh: 然后亲自拜访驻防的将军和浙江学政，
pairs.en: He then personally visited the commander of the local banner garrison and Zhejiang's education commissioner.

pairs.source_zh: 因为这两个人是可以专折奏事的，
pairs.source_en: Both were entitled to submit independent memorials to the throne.
pairs.zh: 因为这两个人是可以专折奏事的，
pairs.en: Both were entitled to submit independent memorials to the throne.

pairs.source_zh: 先要把他们稳住，才可以不使真相上闻。
pairs.source_en: He first had to secure their cooperation if the truth was to be kept from the emperor.
pairs.zh: 先要把他们稳住，才可以不使真相上闻。
pairs.en: He first had to secure their cooperation if the truth was to be kept from the emperor.

pairs.source_zh: 当然，另一方面他还要间接拜托旗籍的官员，安抚椿寿的家属，然后奏报藩司出缺。
pairs.source_en: Meanwhile, he used intermediaries to ask banner officials to placate Chunshou's family, then reported that the provincial treasurer's post had fallen vacant.
pairs.zh: 当然，另一方面他还要间接拜托旗籍的官员，安抚椿寿的家属，然后奏报藩司出缺。
pairs.en: Meanwhile, he used intermediaries to ask banner officials to placate Chunshou's family, then reported that the provincial treasurer's post had fallen vacant.

pairs.source_zh: 上吊自杀是瞒不住的，
pairs.source_en: The suicide itself could not be concealed.
pairs.zh: 上吊自杀是瞒不住的，
pairs.en: The suicide itself could not be concealed.

pairs.source_zh: 所以另外附了个“夹片”，说是“浙江钱漕诸务支出，
pairs.source_en: Huang therefore attached a supplementary note: “The administration of Zhejiang's revenues and grain entails many expenditures.
pairs.zh: 所以另外附了个“夹片”，说是“浙江钱漕诸务支出，
pairs.en: Huang therefore attached a supplementary note: “The administration of Zhejiang's revenues and grain entails many expenditures.

pairs.source_zh: 本年久旱岁歉，征解尤难，
pairs.source_en: This year, prolonged drought and a poor harvest have made collection and remittance especially difficult.
pairs.zh: 本年久旱岁歉，征解尤难，
pairs.en: This year, prolonged drought and a poor harvest have made collection and remittance especially difficult.

pairs.source_zh: 该司恐误公事，日夜焦急，以至迫切轻生。”
pairs.source_en: Fearing that official business would suffer, the treasurer grew anxious day and night until, overcome by desperation, he took his own life.”
pairs.zh: 该司恐误公事，日夜焦急，以至迫切轻生。”
pairs.en: Fearing that official business would suffer, the treasurer grew anxious day and night until, overcome by desperation, he took his own life.”

pairs.source_zh: 把湖属八帮应运漕米，留浙变价的事，只字不提，
pairs.source_en: He made no mention of the order to retain and sell the Huzhou grain.
pairs.zh: 把湖属八帮应运漕米，留浙变价的事，只字不提，
pairs.en: He made no mention of the order to retain and sell the Huzhou grain.

pairs.source_zh: 同时录呈了经过修改的椿寿的遗嘱。
pairs.source_en: He also submitted an altered copy of Chunshou's final statement.
pairs.zh: 同时录呈了经过修改的椿寿的遗嘱。
pairs.en: He also submitted an altered copy of Chunshou's final statement.

pairs.source_zh: 咸丰帝此时初登大宝，相当精明，看遗嘱内有“因情节所逼，势不能生”两句话，大为疑惑，
pairs.source_en: The Xianfeng emperor, newly enthroned and still quite discerning, was struck by two phrases in it: “Driven by the circumstances, I can no longer live.”
pairs.zh: 咸丰帝此时初登大宝，相当精明，看遗嘱内有“因情节所逼，势不能生”两句话，大为疑惑，
pairs.en: The Xianfeng emperor, newly enthroned and still quite discerning, was struck by two phrases in it: “Driven by the circumstances, I can no longer live.”

pairs.source_zh: 认为即令公事难办，何至遽尔自尽？
pairs.source_en: Even if official business was difficult, why should it lead so abruptly to suicide?
pairs.zh: 认为即令公事难办，何至遽尔自尽？
pairs.en: Even if official business was difficult, why should it lead so abruptly to suicide?

pairs.source_zh: 是否另有别情，命令黄宗汉“再行详细访察，据实奏闻，毋稍隐饰。”
pairs.source_en: Suspecting another cause, he ordered Huang to “make further detailed inquiries and report the facts, concealing nothing.”
pairs.zh: 是否另有别情，命令黄宗汉“再行详细访察，据实奏闻，毋稍隐饰。”
pairs.en: Suspecting another cause, he ordered Huang to “make further detailed inquiries and report the facts, concealing nothing.”

pairs.source_zh: 接着，浙江学政万青藜也有专折奏报，
pairs.source_en: Zhejiang's education commissioner, Wan Qingli, then submitted his own memorial.
pairs.zh: 接着，浙江学政万青藜也有专折奏报，
pairs.en: Zhejiang's education commissioner, Wan Qingli, then submitted his own memorial.

pairs.source_zh: 说椿寿身后，留有遗嘱，“实因公事棘手，遽行自尽。”
pairs.source_en: He stated that Chunshou had left a final declaration and “had indeed taken his own life because official business had become intractable.”
pairs.zh: 说椿寿身后，留有遗嘱，“实因公事棘手，遽行自尽。”
pairs.en: He stated that Chunshou had left a final declaration and “had indeed taken his own life because official business had become intractable.”

pairs.source_zh: 与黄宗汉的奏折，桴鼓相应。
pairs.source_en: This neatly echoed Huang's account.
pairs.zh: 与黄宗汉的奏折，桴鼓相应。
pairs.en: This neatly echoed Huang's account.

pairs.source_zh: 皇帝批示：“已有旨，令黄宗汉详查具报。
pairs.source_en: The emperor replied: “An order has already been issued directing Huang Zonghan to investigate thoroughly and report.
pairs.zh: 皇帝批示：“已有旨，令黄宗汉详查具报。
pairs.en: The emperor replied: “An order has already been issued directing Huang Zonghan to investigate thoroughly and report.

pairs.source_zh: 汝近在省垣，若有所闻，亦可据实具奏。”
pairs.source_en: Since you are in the provincial capital, you too may submit a factual report if anything comes to your attention.”
pairs.zh: 汝近在省垣，若有所闻，亦可据实具奏。”
pairs.en: Since you are in the provincial capital, you too may submit a factual report if anything comes to your attention.”

pairs.source_zh: 看来事情要闹得很大，但事态真正严重的关键所在，只有黄宗汉自己知道。
pairs.source_en: The affair seemed likely to grow serious, but only Huang knew where the real danger lay.
pairs.zh: 看来事情要闹得很大，但事态真正严重的关键所在，只有黄宗汉自己知道。
pairs.en: The affair seemed likely to grow serious, but only Huang knew where the real danger lay.

pairs.source_zh: 因为椿寿的自尽，如果真的是由于他的措施严峻、则虽良心有愧，亦不过课以道义上的责任，在公事上可以交代得过，
pairs.source_en: If Chunshou had truly killed himself merely because Huang's administrative measures were severe, Huang might feel guilty and bear moral responsibility, yet he could still defend his official conduct.
pairs.zh: 因为椿寿的自尽，如果真的是由于他的措施严峻、则虽良心有愧，亦不过课以道义上的责任，在公事上可以交代得过，
pairs.en: If Chunshou had truly killed himself merely because Huang's administrative measures were severe, Huang might feel guilty and bear moral responsibility, yet he could still defend his official conduct.

pairs.source_zh: 那就不必有所畏惧。
pairs.source_en: There would have been little to fear.
pairs.zh: 那就不必有所畏惧。
pairs.en: There would have been little to fear.

pairs.source_zh: 而事实上并非如此，
pairs.source_en: But that was not what had happened.
pairs.zh: 而事实上并非如此，
pairs.en: But that was not what had happened.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿之死，是死在他虚言恫吓的一句话上。
pairs.source_en: Chunshou had died because of a false statement Huang had used to intimidate him.
pairs.zh: 椿寿之死，是死在他虚言恫吓的一句话上。
pairs.en: Chunshou had died because of a false statement Huang had used to intimidate him.

pairs.source_zh: 所谓“留浙变价”，原是黄宗汉有意跟椿寿为难的一种说法，
pairs.source_en: The proposal to retain and sell the grain in Zhejiang had been devised to make Chunshou's life difficult.
pairs.zh: 所谓“留浙变价”，原是黄宗汉有意跟椿寿为难的一种说法，
pairs.en: The proposal to retain and sell the grain in Zhejiang had been devised to make Chunshou's life difficult.

pairs.source_zh: 暗地里他并不坚持这样做，
pairs.source_en: In private, Huang did not insist upon it.
pairs.zh: 暗地里他并不坚持这样做，
pairs.en: In private, Huang did not insist upon it.

pairs.source_zh: 不但不坚持，他还留着后手，以防椿寿无法做到时，自己有转圜的余地。
pairs.source_en: Indeed, he had kept another course in reserve so that, if Chunshou could not comply, he himself would still have room to manoeuvre.
pairs.zh: 不但不坚持，他还留着后手，以防椿寿无法做到时，自己有转圜的余地。
pairs.en: Indeed, he had kept another course in reserve so that, if Chunshou could not comply, he himself would still have room to manoeuvre.

pairs.source_zh: 由于在军机处和户部都有极好的关系，所以黄宗汉对来年新漕改用海运，以及本年湖属各帮漕米，不能如限北运的处置办法，都有十足的把握，
pairs.source_en: With excellent connections in both the Grand Council and the Board of Revenue, Huang was entirely confident about securing sea transport for the following year's grain and about the arrangements for this year's Huzhou grain, which could not be sent north within the prescribed time.
pairs.zh: 由于在军机处和户部都有极好的关系，所以黄宗汉对来年新漕改用海运，以及本年湖属各帮漕米，不能如限北运的处置办法，都有十足的把握，
pairs.en: With excellent connections in both the Grand Council and the Board of Revenue, Huang was entirely confident about securing sea transport for the following year's grain and about the arrangements for this year's Huzhou grain, which could not be sent north within the prescribed time.

pairs.source_zh: 私底下书函往还，几乎已有成议。
pairs.source_en: Private correspondence had already brought these matters close to agreement.
pairs.zh: 私底下书函往还，几乎已有成议。
pairs.en: Private correspondence had already brought these matters close to agreement.

pairs.source_zh: 但这些情形，椿寿无从知道，他亦瞒着不说。
pairs.source_en: Chunshou had no way of knowing this, and Huang deliberately kept him in the dark.
pairs.zh: 但这些情形，椿寿无从知道，他亦瞒着不说。
pairs.en: Chunshou had no way of knowing this, and Huang deliberately kept him in the dark.

pairs.source_zh: 以改用海运并无把握，河运粮船难以依限回空的理由，下令截回漕船，留浙变价，
pairs.source_en: Claiming that sea transport remained uncertain and that the canal boats could not return on schedule, Huang ordered the fleet recalled and the grain sold in Zhejiang.
pairs.zh: 以改用海运并无把握，河运粮船难以依限回空的理由，下令截回漕船，留浙变价，
pairs.en: Claiming that sea transport remained uncertain and that the canal boats could not return on schedule, Huang ordered the fleet recalled and the grain sold in Zhejiang.

pairs.source_zh: 这一套措施与他所奏报的改革办法，完全不符。
pairs.source_en: These measures were wholly at odds with the reforms he had actually proposed to the throne.
pairs.zh: 这一套措施与他所奏报的改革办法，完全不符。
pairs.en: These measures were wholly at odds with the reforms he had actually proposed to the throne.

pairs.source_zh: 他向椿寿所说的，留浙变价一事，“已经出奏”，事情到了推车撞壁的地步，再也无可挽回，
pairs.source_en: When he told Chunshou that the decision to sell the grain had “already been reported,” he made it appear that matters had reached an immovable barrier and that no remedy remained.
pairs.zh: 他向椿寿所说的，留浙变价一事，“已经出奏”，事情到了推车撞壁的地步，再也无可挽回，
pairs.en: When he told Chunshou that the decision to sell the grain had “already been reported,” he made it appear that matters had reached an immovable barrier and that no remedy remained.

pairs.source_zh: 这才使椿寿感到已入绝路，不能不一死了之。
pairs.source_en: That was what persuaded Chunshou that he had reached a dead end and could only die.
pairs.zh: 这才使椿寿感到已入绝路，不能不一死了之。
pairs.en: That was what persuaded Chunshou that he had reached a dead end and could only die.

pairs.source_zh: 其实，“已经出奏”这句话，根本是瞎说。
pairs.source_en: In fact, the claim that the decision had already been reported was a complete fabrication.
pairs.zh: 其实，“已经出奏”这句话，根本是瞎说。
pairs.en: In fact, the claim that the decision had already been reported was a complete fabrication.

pairs.source_zh: 就凭这句谎言，黄宗汉便得对椿寿之死，负起全部责任。
pairs.source_en: That lie alone made Huang fully responsible for Chunshou's death.
pairs.zh: 就凭这句谎言，黄宗汉便得对椿寿之死，负起全部责任。
pairs.en: That lie alone made Huang fully responsible for Chunshou's death.

pairs.source_zh: 因而他必须多方设法掩饰遮盖，不使真相上闻，
pairs.source_en: He therefore had to do everything possible to conceal the truth from the throne.
pairs.zh: 因而他必须多方设法掩饰遮盖，不使真相上闻，
pairs.en: He therefore had to do everything possible to conceal the truth from the throne.

pairs.source_zh: 一面活动万青藜等人，帮着他瞒谎，一面遣派亲信，携带巨贤，到京师活动。
pairs.source_en: While persuading Wan Qingli and others to help sustain the deception, he sent trusted men to the capital with large sums of money to work on his behalf.
pairs.zh: 一面活动万青藜等人，帮着他瞒谎，一面遣派亲信，携带巨贤，到京师活动。
pairs.en: While persuading Wan Qingli and others to help sustain the deception, he sent trusted men to the capital with large sums of money to work on his behalf.

pairs.source_zh: 当然，象军机大臣彭蕴章那里，是不必也不能行贿的，
pairs.source_en: With someone like Grand Councillor Peng Yunzhang, of course, bribery was neither necessary nor possible.
pairs.zh: 当然，象军机大臣彭蕴章那里，是不必也不能行贿的，
pairs.en: With someone like Grand Councillor Peng Yunzhang, of course, bribery was neither necessary nor possible.

pairs.source_zh: 只有以同年的身份，拜托关顾照应。
pairs.source_en: Huang could only appeal to their bond as examination classmates and ask for his protection.
pairs.zh: 只有以同年的身份，拜托关顾照应。
pairs.en: Huang could only appeal to their bond as examination classmates and ask for his protection.

pairs.source_zh: 不过这样一件案子，也不是轻易压得下去的。
pairs.source_en: Even so, a case like this could not easily be suppressed.
pairs.zh: 不过这样一件案子，也不是轻易压得下去的。
pairs.en: Even so, a case like this could not easily be suppressed.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿是“上三旗”的旗人，亲戚之中，颇有贵官，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou belonged to the Upper Three Banners and had highly placed relatives.
pairs.zh: 椿寿是“上三旗”的旗人，亲戚之中，颇有贵官，
pairs.en: Chunshou belonged to the Upper Three Banners and had highly placed relatives.

pairs.source_zh: 认为他的死因可疑，自然要出头为他讲话，
pairs.source_en: They suspected that his death had a hidden cause and naturally spoke up for him.
pairs.zh: 认为他的死因可疑，自然要出头为他讲话，
pairs.en: They suspected that his death had a hidden cause and naturally spoke up for him.

pairs.source_zh: 这样军机处要帮黄宗汉的忙，就不能不费一番手脚，来遮人耳目。
pairs.source_en: If the Grand Council was to help Huang, it would have to take some pains to conceal what it was doing.
pairs.zh: 这样军机处要帮黄宗汉的忙，就不能不费一番手脚，来遮人耳目。
pairs.en: If the Grand Council was to help Huang, it would have to take some pains to conceal what it was doing.

pairs.source_zh: 照一向的惯例，类似这种情况，一定简派大员密查。
pairs.source_en: In such circumstances, established practice called for a senior official to conduct a secret investigation.
pairs.zh: 照一向的惯例，类似这种情况，一定简派大员密查。
pairs.en: In such circumstances, established practice called for a senior official to conduct a secret investigation.

pairs.source_zh: 既称密查，自然不能让被查的人知道，
pairs.source_en: Naturally, the person under investigation was not supposed to know.
pairs.zh: 既称密查，自然不能让被查的人知道，
pairs.en: Naturally, the person under investigation was not supposed to know.

pairs.source_zh: 可是一二品的大员出京，无论如何是件瞒不住的事，
pairs.source_en: Yet the departure from the capital of a first- or second-rank official could hardly be hidden.
pairs.zh: 可是一二品的大员出京，无论如何是件瞒不住的事，
pairs.en: Yet the departure from the capital of a first- or second-rank official could hardly be hidden.

pairs.source_zh: 于是便有许多掩护其行踪及任务的方法，
pairs.source_en: Various methods were therefore used to disguise his route and assignment.
pairs.zh: 于是便有许多掩护其行踪及任务的方法，
pairs.en: Various methods were therefore used to disguise his route and assignment.

pairs.source_zh: 一种是声东击西，
pairs.source_en: One was to announce one destination while aiming at another.
pairs.zh: 一种是声东击西，
pairs.en: One was to announce one destination while aiming at another.

pairs.source_zh: 譬如明发上谕：“着派某某人驰往江苏查案”，
pairs.source_en: A public edict might, for instance, order a named official to proceed urgently to Jiangsu to investigate a case.
pairs.zh: 譬如明发上谕：“着派某某人驰往江苏查案”，
pairs.en: A public edict might, for instance, order a named official to proceed urgently to Jiangsu to investigate a case.

pairs.source_zh: 这人便是“钦差”的身分，所经之处，接待的礼节极其隆重。
pairs.source_en: Travelling as an imperial commissioner, he would receive elaborate honours along the way.
pairs.zh: 这人便是“钦差”的身分，所经之处，接待的礼节极其隆重。
pairs.en: Travelling as an imperial commissioner, he would receive elaborate honours along the way.

pairs.source_zh: 这样一路南下，到了济南，忽然不定了，
pairs.source_en: On reaching Jinan, however, he would suddenly stop.
pairs.zh: 这样一路南下，到了济南，忽然不定了，
pairs.en: On reaching Jinan, however, he would suddenly stop.

pairs.source_zh: 用钦差大臣的关防，咨会山东巡抚，开出一张名单，请即传提到案，迅雷不及掩耳地展开了查案的工作。
pairs.source_en: Using his commissioner's seal, he would send the governor of Shandong a list of people to be summoned immediately, launching the investigation before anyone had time to prepare.
pairs.zh: 用钦差大臣的关防，咨会山东巡抚，开出一张名单，请即传提到案，迅雷不及掩耳地展开了查案的工作。
pairs.en: Using his commissioner's seal, he would send the governor of Shandong a list of people to be summoned immediately, launching the investigation before anyone had time to prepare.

pairs.source_zh: 再有一种是暗渡陈仓，乘某某大员外放到任的机会，密谕赴某处查案。
pairs.source_en: Another method was to use an outwardly ordinary appointment as cover: a senior official leaving the capital to take up a provincial post would receive secret instructions to investigate a case elsewhere on the way.
pairs.zh: 再有一种是暗渡陈仓，乘某某大员外放到任的机会，密谕赴某处查案。
pairs.en: Another method was to use an outwardly ordinary appointment as cover: a senior official leaving the capital to take up a provincial post would receive secret instructions to investigate a case elsewhere on the way.

pairs.source_zh: 这道密谕照例不发“邸抄”，被查的省分，毫无所知，
pairs.source_en: Such instructions were not published in the official court gazette, so the province concerned knew nothing of them.
pairs.zh: 这道密谕照例不发“邸抄”，被查的省分，毫无所知，
pairs.en: Such instructions were not published in the official court gazette, so the province concerned knew nothing of them.

pairs.source_zh: 行到目的地，拜访总督或巡抚，出示密谕，
pairs.source_en: On reaching his destination, the investigator called on the governor-general or governor and produced the secret edict.
pairs.zh: 行到目的地，拜访总督或巡抚，出示密谕，
pairs.en: On reaching his destination, the investigator called on the governor-general or governor and produced the secret edict.

pairs.source_zh: 于是一夕之间，可以掀起大狱。
pairs.source_en: A major judicial inquiry could thus erupt overnight.
pairs.zh: 于是一夕之间，可以掀起大狱。
pairs.en: A major judicial inquiry could thus erupt overnight.

pairs.source_zh: 查黄宗汉逼死椿寿一案，就是用的这一种办法，
pairs.source_en: This was the method chosen to investigate Huang's role in driving Chunshou to his death.
pairs.zh: 查黄宗汉逼死椿寿一案，就是用的这一种办法，
pairs.en: This was the method chosen to investigate Huang's role in driving Chunshou to his death.

pairs.source_zh: 所以在表面上看不出黄宗汉出了毛病的痕迹。这当然又是军机处帮他的忙。
pairs.source_en: Outwardly, there was therefore no sign that Huang was in trouble—another favour done him by the Grand Council.
pairs.zh: 所以在表面上看不出黄宗汉出了毛病的痕迹。这当然又是军机处帮他的忙。
pairs.en: Outwardly, there was therefore no sign that Huang was in trouble—another favour done him by the Grand Council.

pairs.source_zh: 这位钦差名叫何桂清，是黄宗汉的同年。
pairs.source_en: The commissioner chosen was He Guiqing, Huang's examination classmate.
pairs.zh: 这位钦差名叫何桂清，是黄宗汉的同年。
pairs.en: The commissioner chosen was He Guiqing, Huang's examination classmate.

pairs.source_zh: 在他们乙未一榜中，何桂清的年纪比较轻，
pairs.source_en: Among the successful candidates of their yiwei year, He was relatively young.
pairs.zh: 在他们乙未一榜中，何桂清的年纪比较轻，
pairs.en: Among the successful candidates of their yiwei year, He was relatively young.

pairs.source_zh: 仪表清俊，吐嘱渊雅，人缘极好。
pairs.source_en: Handsome, refined in speech, and graceful in manner, he was exceptionally well liked.
pairs.zh: 仪表清俊，吐嘱渊雅，人缘极好。
pairs.en: Handsome, refined in speech, and graceful in manner, he was exceptionally well liked.

pairs.source_zh: 这年秋天，由户部侍郎外放江苏学政，
pairs.source_en: That autumn he had been transferred from a vice-presidency at the Board of Revenue to the post of education commissioner in Jiangsu.
pairs.zh: 这年秋天，由户部侍郎外放江苏学政，
pairs.en: That autumn he had been transferred from a vice-presidency at the Board of Revenue to the post of education commissioner in Jiangsu.

pairs.source_zh: 在京里饯行送别的应酬甚多，所以一直迟迟不能启程。
pairs.source_en: So many farewell engagements awaited him in the capital that his departure was repeatedly delayed.
pairs.zh: 在京里饯行送别的应酬甚多，所以一直迟迟不能启程。
pairs.en: So many farewell engagements awaited him in the capital that his departure was repeatedly delayed.

pairs.source_zh: 就在这殷摒挡行囊，准备到任的期间内，出了椿寿这件案子，
pairs.source_en: Chunshou's case arose while he was making ready to leave.
pairs.zh: 就在这殷摒挡行囊，准备到任的期间内，出了椿寿这件案子，
pairs.en: Chunshou's case arose while he was making ready to leave.

pairs.source_zh: 彭蕴章和他一些在京同年商量的结果，奏请密派问桂清于赴江苏学政途中，顺道查办。
pairs.source_en: After consulting other examination classmates in the capital, Peng Yunzhang proposed that He be secretly instructed to investigate it on his way to Jiangsu.
pairs.zh: 彭蕴章和他一些在京同年商量的结果，奏请密派问桂清于赴江苏学政途中，顺道查办。
pairs.en: After consulting other examination classmates in the capital, Peng Yunzhang proposed that He be secretly instructed to investigate it on his way to Jiangsu.

pairs.source_zh: “上头”只对椿寿的死因怀疑，不曾想到是他所信任的黄宗汉干的好事，
pairs.source_en: The emperor suspected something about Chunshou's death, but had not imagined that Huang, whom he trusted, was responsible.
pairs.zh: “上头”只对椿寿的死因怀疑，不曾想到是他所信任的黄宗汉干的好事，
pairs.en: The emperor suspected something about Chunshou's death, but had not imagined that Huang, whom he trusted, was responsible.

pairs.source_zh: 自然不会以何桂清与黄是同年为嫌，便准了军机处的建议。
pairs.source_en: He therefore saw no reason to object to He's relationship with Huang and approved the Grand Council's recommendation.
pairs.zh: 自然不会以何桂清与黄是同年为嫌，便准了军机处的建议。
pairs.en: He therefore saw no reason to object to He's relationship with Huang and approved the Grand Council's recommendation.

pairs.source_zh: 这个消息，很快、很秘密地传到了杭州，
pairs.source_en: The news reached Hangzhou swiftly and in strict secrecy.
pairs.zh: 这个消息，很快、很秘密地传到了杭州，
pairs.en: The news reached Hangzhou swiftly and in strict secrecy.

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉等于服下一位定心丸。
pairs.source_en: To Huang, it was profoundly reassuring.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉等于服下一位定心丸。
pairs.en: To Huang, it was profoundly reassuring.

pairs.source_zh: 何桂清以钦命在身，不敢耽搁，
pairs.source_en: With an imperial commission now entrusted to him, He Guiqing dared delay no longer.
pairs.zh: 何桂清以钦命在身，不敢耽搁，
pairs.en: With an imperial commission now entrusted to him, He Guiqing dared delay no longer.

pairs.source_zh: 也就在岁暮之际，出京南下。
pairs.source_en: As the year drew to its close, he left the capital and headed south.
pairs.zh: 也就在岁暮之际，出京南下。
pairs.en: As the year drew to its close, he left the capital and headed south.
